624 changes

Changes to the Claude Code toolkit, newest week first, in the Keep a Changelog groups: Added (a new agent, skill, script or hook), Changed (a behavior change to an existing one), Removed (deleted), Fixed (a defect repaired), Security and Deprecated. A line that starts with Regression: is a fix for a bug that an earlier change caused. A line that ends with (reverted by ...) was undone by the change named there.

## Highlights

### Cost and speed

* [/code now runs its review loop as a script instead of an agent](2026-10-27-code-runs-the-review-loop-as-a-script.md): **cuts tokens by 42% (1.3M → 751k)** [script/code-step, script/review-loop-script, script/format-changed] ([2026-10-26-scripted-review-loop-with-bounded-re-review-vs](../../../agent-evals/findings/2026-10-26-scripted-review-loop-with-bounded-re-review-vs.md))
* [The plan reviewer runs on about two fifths fewer tokens without the batch-your-tree-checks instruction](2026-09-13-the-plan-reviewer-s-instruction-to-batch-its-tree.md): **cuts tokens by 38% (1.3M → 800k)** [agent/plan-reviewer] ([2026-09-12-tokbatch-1](../../../agent-evals/findings/2026-09-12-tokbatch-1.md))
* [One `coder` now builds a full-stack change, with no frontend/backend fence](2026-08-04-fe-be-coder-split-one-unfenced-coder-for-fullstack.md): **cuts cost by 36% ($140.93 → $89.97)** [agent/coder] ([2026-07-12-seam-ab-r2](../../../agent-evals/findings/2026-07-12-seam-ab-r2.md))

### Quality

* [Coder hand-back gate lists stale comment and doc lines](2026-10-25-coder-hand-back-gate-lists-stale-comment-and-doc.md): **cuts stale doc lines left of 15 by 72% (12.1 → 3.4)** [agent/coder, skill/code, agent/code-reviewer] ([2026-10-25-stale-prose-hand-back-check-with-a-value-only](../../../agent-evals/findings/2026-10-25-stale-prose-hand-back-check-with-a-value-only.md))

## Week of 2026-10-26

### Added

* [goal-blind researcher cannot hand back while its child still runs](2026-10-26-goal-blind-researcher-cannot-hand-back-while-its.md) [agent/goal-blind-researcher] A new PreToolUse hook on SubagentHandback denies goal-blind-researcher's first hand-back while a child it dispatched is still open, once per agent, and fails open.
* [The /code fork runs as an agent with no Edit or Write tool](2026-10-26-the-code-fork-runs-as-an-agent-with-no-edit-or.md) [skill/code, script/code-step] The /code skill forks into a new code-fork agent that has no Edit, Write or NotebookEdit tool, so the fork can no longer implement a brief itself and skip the coder gate and review loop.
* [The eng-spec dry run checks every phase and flags broken count and pgrep criteria](2026-10-26-the-eng-spec-dry-run-checks-every-phase-and-flags.md) [script/criteria-dry-run, skill/eng-spec] A new script runs every Automated Verification command of every phase and flags a self-matching pgrep -f and a count that differs from the plan's own code.

### Changed

* [Callers read the review store from handback_store, not through handback](2026-10-29-callers-read-the-review-store-from-handback-store.md) [script/review] handback.py drops its re-export block; every caller imports the hand-back store names from handback_store and the finding-id constants from loop_transcript.
* [The Automated Verification reader and skill-done evidence leave code_step_boundary](2026-10-29-the-automated-verification-reader-and-skill-done.md) [script/code-step] The Automated Verification reader moves to code_step_verification.py and the skill-done evidence to code_step_closing.py, so code_step_boundary.py drops from 1021 to 706 lines.
* [The summary after an asks round leads with the current asks coder](2026-10-29-the-summary-after-an-asks-round-leads-with-the.md) [script/code-step] After a round of review asks, the /code review summary leads with the current asks coder's report, shows earlier asks rounds as one line each, and drops the why notes the asks coder replaced.
* [Code-step stop state lives in one record](2026-10-29-code-step-stop-state-lives-in-one-record.md) [script/code-step] The /code step keeps every stop fact in state['stop'] and its baselines in state['snapshot'], an old state file migrates on read, and the unread packet key and duplicate asksApplied are gone.
* [The review-loop transcript reader moves to lib](2026-10-29-the-review-loop-transcript-reader-moves-to-lib.md) [script/handback, script/review-loop-gate, script/open-child-gate] LoopTranscript and the checks that read only the transcript move from review_loop_gate.py to lib/loop_transcript.py, so handback.py no longer imports the SubagentStop hook that imports it.
* [The review status stops move to their own module](2026-10-29-the-review-status-stops-move-to-their-own-module.md) [skill/code] code_step's review status stops (tool fault, critical blocker, setup fault, unverified check, review cap) move from code_step_review.py to code_step_review_stops.py, with no change in what a run prints or saves.
* [Small path and parser helpers have one owner each](2026-10-29-small-path-and-parser-helpers-have-one-owner-each.md) [script/code-step, script/coder-gate, script/coder-packet, script/plan-format, script/script-utils, script/review-commit-gate, script/review-fix, script/review-loop-script, script/deferred-push-check, script/batch-reads-nudge, script/review-loop-gate] Duplicated path builders, status and JSONL parsers, deny output and review-again text in the code and review scripts now call one owner each, and plan section scans skip code fences.
* [One module logs review ask ids and outcomes for /review and /code](2026-10-29-one-module-logs-review-ask-ids-and-outcomes-for.md) [skill/review, skill/code] A new review_asks.py fills ask ids and logs ask outcome rows for both /review and /code, so a plan-impact ask now gets no id and no outcome row in /code, as in /review.
* [A ruled review ask says what its outcome did and names the change](2026-10-29-a-ruled-review-ask-names-the-change-its-outcome.md) [script/code-step] The ruled-asks line that later reviews and the closing pass read now says what each outcome did to the code and names the change, and puts the phase it was ruled in last, so an ask that offers phases no longer reads as answered by that phase.
* [Review findings are records after one parse](2026-10-29-review-findings-are-records-after-one-parse.md) [script/review-loop-script, script/full-check-gate] Review-loop findings are parsed once into Finding records, and a merged finding keeps its parts as a list instead of text joined with ' Also reported: ', so each part keeps its own path and line.
* [The coder gate ranks its outcomes in one place](2026-10-29-the-coder-gate-ranks-its-outcomes-in-one-place.md) [script/coder-gate, script/code-step, script/script-utils] The scoped test run and the hand-back hook rank a mixed result with one gate_outcome(), so a setup fault beside a command error reports a command error in both, and each coder's gate record holds one per-command outcome map.
* [Review loop uses the shared test and lockfile path rules](2026-10-29-review-loop-uses-the-shared-test-and-lockfile-path.md) [script/review-loop-script] The scripted review loop routes tests to the test reviewer and sizes a change by the same test and lockfile rules as the other scripts, so __tests__/, test_*.py, *_test.* and nested tests/ files and every lockfile are recognised. Generated, dist/, snapshot and .min.js files also no longer count toward the size bar.
* [The ask question shows one change flag after each modified outcome](2026-10-29-the-ask-question-shows-one-change-flag-after-each.md) [script/code-step] The /code question for review asks spells out the asks-done layout, a --change right after each modified word, so the first answer parses.
* [Sign-offs go only in the decision log](2026-10-29-sign-offs-go-only-in-the-decision-log.md) [rule/global-claude-md, skill/coder-core] The global AC rule now names where a sign-off is recorded: the plan's decision log, never code, comments, fixtures or commit messages. coder-core bans the user's name and sign-offs from every file a coder writes.
* [The review hand-back shows counts in place of the fixed nit and skipped lists](2026-10-28-the-review-hand-back-shows-counts-in-place-of-the.md) [script/handback] handback.render drops the Fixed, Nits and Skipped lists from the user text of /review, /fix and code_step and prints one count line, such as Fixed 4, nits 2, skipped 1. Open blockers (the stop statuses), remaining and deferred findings, blocked agents, asks, check lines and the class-closure line stay; a fixed blocker is counted under Fixed. The logged rows are unchanged.
* [The session shows each adopted plan deviation, and a later review drops a stale one](2026-10-28-the-session-shows-each-adopted-plan-deviation.md) [script/review-fix, script/handback, script/code-step, script/plan-format, skill/fix, skill/review, agent/code-reviewer, agent/review-loop] A plan impact adopted below the acceptance criteria prints one deviation line, with no question: in code_step's say.md at phase end and run end, and in the /review and /fix closing block. Adopted deviations carry into a re-dispatch only when the dispatch prompt holds the resolved plan_impact; any other review shows none.
* [A plan conflict that changes no acceptance criterion is adopted without asking](2026-10-28-a-plan-conflict-that-changes-no-acceptance.md) [script/review-fix, script/code-step, script/plan-format, skill/coder-core, agent/code-reviewer, agent/review-loop, skill/review, skill/fix] A PLAN-IMPACT block now ends with an acceptance_criteria line. When every block says none, /review, /fix and /code adopt the plan change by rule, log it under Plan Deviations as the session's ruling, and re-dispatch with no question to the user. Any other value, or no line at all, still asks.
* [A main push line waits for the branch's verify-branch and non-negotiables results](2026-10-28-a-main-push-line-waits-for-the-branch-s-verify-branch.md) [rule/orchestration] The orchestration file's Git section now says the orchestrator hands a push or merge line for main only after the branch reports /verify-branch done and, where the repo's CLAUDE.md names a non-negotiables check, that check passed; a green gate or CI run alone never produces that line.
* [The code_step test file runs the script in-process](2026-10-28-the-code-step-test-file-runs-the-script-in-process.md) [script/code-step] test_code_step.py runs code_step.main() in the test process instead of starting python3 for each of about 4,000 script calls, and one review wait test stops waiting 15 seconds for a stop row it never writes. The file goes from 339 s to 141 s run alone.
* [Review-loop fix coders run only the tests for the files they changed](2026-10-28-review-loop-fix-coders-run-only-the-tests-for-the.md) [agent/review-loop] Every coder prompt the review loop builds tells the coder to run only the tests for its changed files, never lint suites, the full suite or repo-wide checks, since the loop runs the full check after the pass.
* [The termination walk runs staged scripts in-process](2026-10-28-the-termination-walk-runs-staged-scripts-in.md) [script/code-step] The termination walk now runs `coder_gate.py` and `coder_packet.py` in-process and waits ten times less for a row that has not arrived, so the file runs in about half the time with the same visited nodes. Before, it ran them as python3 processes on most nodes.
* [Review scripts share their repeated reads and messages](2026-10-28-review-scripts-share-their-repeated-reads-and.md) [script/review-fix, script/handback, script/deferred-push-check, script/verify-common, script/open-child-gate] The review scripts drop hand-written copies of a session-row read, a skill-file update, a keep-dirty sentence, a deny line and an error translation, with no behavior change.
* [The gate scripts drop duplicate checks and hand-built deny output](2026-10-28-the-gate-scripts-drop-duplicate-checks-and-hand.md) [script/review-commit-gate, script/code-step, script/coder-gate] A refactor with no behavior change: the review-commit gate's second folder-change check folds into its first, the /code hooks share one fork-block helper, and the hand-back gate uses the shared deny printer and table-driven report text.
* [Fold code_step_restart into code_step_start and inline the one-line resume wrappers](2026-10-28-fold-code-step-restart-into-code-step-start-and.md) [script/code-step] code_step_restart.py's two functions move into code_step_start.py, their only caller, and the eight resume handlers that only forwarded to a command become entries in RESUME_HANDLERS. No behavior change.
* [review-loop hands back once, after the full check](2026-10-27-review-loop-hands-back-once-after-the-full-check.md) [script/handback, script/review-loop-gate, script/open-child-gate] The hand-back hook denies a review-loop report with no full check after its last code change, and denies a second report from an agent whose first was delivered; the stop gate no longer sends a delivered loop back to work.
* [A failed full check names its failing step's lines](2026-10-27-a-failed-full-check-names-its-failing-step-lines.md) [script/review-loop, agent/review-loop] full_check puts the lint errors and FAIL lines in a failed check's blocker, calls a step that stops on a missing path a check-command error, and the check finder keeps a workflow's default working directory on every step.
* [A repo with no check found is reviewed, and the hand-back says no full check ran](2026-10-27-a-repo-with-no-check-found-is-reviewed.md) [script/review-loop-script, agent/review-loop] When neither CLAUDE.md nor the check finder names a full check, the review loop runs its review with the coder's scoped tests standing as the check, and the packet's full_check says so, in place of a critical-blocker stop that a restart only repeats.
* [A /code fork replies at once to a mid-run scope message](2026-10-27-a-code-fork-replies-at-once-to-a-mid-run-scope-message.md) [skill/code] The /code skill says a run takes no scope change mid-run: the fork replies to the sender with SendMessage at once and never passes the message on.
* [A verify-only ask whose checks pass with no edit finishes the phase](2026-10-27-a-verify-only-ask-whose-checks-pass-with-no-edit.md) [script/code-step] An asks coder's ALREADY-DONE line may name a backticked command that exited 0, so a verify-only ask whose checks pass with no edit goes on to the end-of-review gate and commit; a report with no such line still stops.
* [A repo whose full suite runs in CI gets only the changed-file tests in review](2026-10-27-a-repo-whose-full-suite-runs-in-ci-gets-only-the.md) [agent/review-loop, script/review-loop-gate, script/review-loop-script] A repo whose CLAUDE.md holds the line `Full suite: CI` skips the review loop's full check and runs the changed files' tests, and a full check past its time limit reports `not run (timeout)` with its process group killed, never a critical blocker.
* [A capped /code review goes on to one more review-loop pass](2026-10-27-a-capped-code-review-goes-on-to-one-more-review.md) [script/code-step, agent/review-loop] A /code review that stops at the round cap takes the user's rulings on its asks, or `review-again` when it has none, and sends the open findings to one more review-loop pass in place of a phase restart.
* [code-step refuses a refactor phase close until the concentration gate is evaluated](2026-10-27-code-step-refuses-a-refactor-phase-close-until-the.md) [script/code-step, skill/code] code-step now counts the added lines itself, prints whether the concentration gate triggers, and refuses to close a triggered gate until a simplify run is named for the module it computed. The record is saved in the plan. Before, a /code refactor closing phase could close with `skill-done pass` and no sign the gate was checked.
* [tests/run.sh ends on a line naming each failed step](2026-10-27-tests-run-sh-ends-on-a-line-naming-each-failed.md) [script/run-sh] When lint, the duplicate check or the tests fail, tests/run.sh ends on a FAILED line naming each failed step, after the test summary, so a lint failure no longer ends on a line that reads as a pass.
* [CI runs the script tests when a script under scripts/.local/bin changes](2026-10-27-ci-runs-the-script-tests-when-a-script-under.md) [script/herdr-worktree, script/agent-cost] The script-tests workflow adds scripts/.local/bin/** to its push and pull_request paths, so an edit to herdr-worktree or another stowed script runs its tests in CI.
* [Only the main session hands the user a command](2026-10-27-only-the-main-session-hands-the-user-a-command.md) [rule/global-claude-md, agent/mutation-tester] The global rules now say a subagent never writes a command for the user to run; it reports the step it could not do to its caller, which runs it or hands it on.
* [Coder core bans interpreter code on stdin and programs that write repo files](2026-10-27-coder-core-bans-interpreter-code-on-stdin-and.md) [skill/coder-core] The coder's list of shell forms the hooks block now names interpreter code fed on stdin (python3 - <<EOF, python3 <<EOF, cat x | python3) and a program the coder wrote that opens a repo file for writing.
* [/code now runs its review loop as a script instead of an agent](2026-10-27-code-runs-the-review-loop-as-a-script.md) [script/code-step, script/review-loop-script, script/format-changed] The /code step script launches review_loop_script.py, where it used to launch the Sonnet review-loop agent: each reviewer, coder and class-closure judgment is its own claude -p call, and scope, parsing, routing, the round cap and the full check are code. **cuts tokens by 42% (1.3M → 751k)**
* [Skills and scripts never need the ledger to finish; verify-branch falls back on any unread ledger](2026-10-27-skills-and-scripts-never-need-the-ledger-to-finish.md) [script/script-utils, script/verify-common, script/verify-log, script/verify-prep, skill/audit, skill/verify-branch] New rule in toolkit-script-rules.md: no skill, agent or script needs the ledger to finish. verify_common now treats a missing or failing ledger like a busy one, so verify-prep and verify-log fall back to the checkout's own record of the logged review.
* [eng-spec stops before handoff when the criteria file was never written](2026-10-26-eng-spec-stops-before-handoff-when-the-criteria.md) [skill/eng-spec] plan check gains --final, which also fails a spec with an Acceptance Criteria section whose acceptance-criteria.md is missing or empty and names the spec-criteria step; eng-spec's handoff runs it before it reports the plan saved.
* [spec-criteria numbers ids flat and runs plan check before it returns](2026-10-26-spec-criteria-numbers-ids-flat-and-runs-plan-check.md) [agent/spec-criteria] spec-criteria gets Bash for one command: it runs plan check on the spec and fixes its criteria file until every remaining row starts with the spec's path, with flat unique ids and no reason text on a verbatim ticket AC line.
* [quality-check-cap tells a denied chain that none of its other steps ran](2026-10-26-quality-check-cap-tells-a-denied-chain-that-none.md) [script/quality-check-cap] When the repeat-check cap denies a multi-step Bash call, the deny text says the whole call was refused for that fragment alone and to send the other steps again as their own call.
* [Main session sends simple commands after EnterWorktree](2026-10-26-main-session-sends-simple-commands-after.md) [rule/orchestration] The orchestration rule says Claude Code's own worktree guard refuses chains, $VAR, $(...) and heredocs after EnterWorktree, and to send one simple command per call with literal paths, in the session and in every subagent brief.
* [Main session and coder are told the Bash shell is zsh](2026-10-26-main-session-and-coder-are-told-the-bash-shell-is.md) [rule/orchestration, skill/coder-core] The orchestration rule and coder-core say an unquoted $VAR stays one word under zsh and splits under bash, and to loop over an array in a form both shells read, or write each command out.
* [code_step.py is split by concern into seven modules](2026-10-26-code-step-py-is-split-by-concern-into-seven.md) [script/code-step] code_step.py drops from 2312 to 605 lines: the start, review, gate and report concerns move into their own modules with each function's text unchanged, so the scripted review loop can be wired in under the toolkit's 1000-line rule.
* [code_step writes question.md on every stop on an agent's report or silence](2026-10-26-code-step-writes-question-md-on-every-stop-on-an.md) [script/code-step, skill/code] Every /code stop on an agent's report or silence (no agent id, wait cap, coder stop, critical blocker, review cap, failed closing check) writes question.md with why, one line per open item and the exact command to go on; `skill-done fail` takes `--finding`.
* [code_step says the plan-rewrite coder's open choices to the user](2026-10-26-code-step-says-the-plan-rewrite-coder-s-open.md) [script/code-step] The plan-rewrite coder may not ask the user; it ends its report with one `OPEN CHOICE:` line per choice the ruling leaves open, and `after-plan-edit` says each one to the user.
* [code_step verification refusal names the phase and offers only a repo script](2026-10-26-code-step-verification-refusal-names-the-phase-and.md) [script/code-step] The refusal for a compound Automated Verification line names the phase each bad line belongs to, says every open phase is checked at each start, and offers only an executable repo script whose comments name no ticket or plan path.
* [code_step phase start carries trailing text to the coder as run notes](2026-10-26-code-step-phase-start-carries-trailing-text-to-the.md) [script/code-step] Text after `<plan> --phase <id>` (or `Phase <id>`) reaches the coder brief as run notes, `start --help` matches the parser, and a closing phase stops on notes it cannot pass on.
* [code_step start reads task text from a file](2026-10-26-code-step-start-reads-task-text-from-a-file.md) [script/code-step, skill/code] `code_step.py start --task-file <path>` reads the task text verbatim from any path, the code skill passes it through, and a positional non-plan file outside the repo is refused with the --task-file command.
* [herdr-worktree fork starts the forked session on a hand-over brief](2026-10-26-herdr-worktree-fork-starts-the-forked-session-on-a.md) [rule/orchestration, script/herdr-worktree, script/herdr-dev] herdr-worktree --fork now takes a required --prompt that the forked Claude session starts on, and the orchestration rule says to pass a brief naming the task, what is done, the next step and that the fork owns the work.
* [Test-audit rows carry their lane, a test file:line or unlocated, and a measured diff size](2026-10-26-test-audit-rows-carry-their-lane-a-test-file-line.md) [skill/test-audit, skill/fix, agent/review-loop, script/review-loop-gate, script/log-review-finding] A /fix started by a test audit passes lane test-audit to its review-loop, whose metrics and run rows now carry it; log-review-finding measures diff_loc from diff_base=<ref> to the working tree, takes file=unlocated, and refuses a test-intent-reviewer finding with no file or line 0.
* [eng-spec plan repairs ask architects for section text, not file edits](2026-10-26-eng-spec-plan-repairs-ask-architects-for-section.md) [skill/eng-spec] When a design gap or a plan-review finding goes back to an architect, eng-spec now asks for the full text of each changed section and writes it into the plan files itself, because architects hold no Edit or Write tool.
* [Review-loop stop hook blocks a packet with unlogged finding rows or a plan-file edit](2026-10-26-review-loop-stop-hook-blocks-a-packet-with.md) [agent/review-loop, script/review-loop-gate] The review-loop stop check blocks once when the packet lists findings with no per-finding ledger rows or no metrics line, or names the plan file in files_touched.
* [The plan check fails a criterion that drifted from the ticket](2026-10-26-the-plan-check-fails-a-criterion-that-drifted-from.md) [skill/eng-spec, agent/spec-criteria, script/plan-format] The eng-spec plan check fails a ticket Acceptance line whose text no AC in the criteria file carries and no sign-off names; a ticket with no Acceptance or Requirements heading is skipped.
* [Plan-review rounds write reviewer reports to files; round two checks them](2026-10-26-plan-review-rounds-write-reviewer-reports-to-files.md) [skill/eng-spec, script/plan-review-reports] Each plan-review round writes every reviewer report to the task directory, and a script check fails round two when a prior round's report file is missing.
* [skill-done pass writes each closing-phase box with its evidence](2026-10-26-skill-done-pass-writes-each-closing-phase-box-with.md) [script/code-step, skill/code] code_step.py skill-done pass now needs one --evidence per open Success Criteria item in a closing phase; it ticks each box and writes a Done line under it, so refactor and test-audit results reach the plan.
* [code-step abort verb ends an open /code run](2026-10-26-code-step-abort-verb-ends-an-open-code-run.md) [script/code-step, skill/code] code_step.py abort drops the open /code run: it archives state.json, clears the say, question and coder-gate files, and prints what it dropped, so the next start begins a fresh run with no restart flag.
* [The hand-back gate runs the cargo commands a phase lists](2026-10-26-the-hand-back-gate-runs-the-cargo-commands-a-phase.md) [script/code-step] When a plan phase lists cargo commands under Automated Verification, code_step.py start sets the hand-back gate to those commands in place of crate-wide clippy and the cargo test commands it derives from the phase's files.

### Removed

* [Remove code_step alias verbs and the resume argparse](2026-10-29-remove-code-step-alias-verbs-and-the-resume.md) [script/code-step] code_step.py no longer accepts the verbs after-coder, after-review and after-plan-edit: each is refused as an unknown verb, and every route runs the stale-phase check except a real hand-back of the run's own agent. A resume answer that starts with a dash is still refused, by a plain check in place of an argument parser.
* [Cull the flow, plan, logging and ledger tests, and delete two dead telemetry scripts](2026-10-29-cull-the-flow-plan-logging-and-ledger-tests-and.md) [script/log-skill-use, script/test-edit-telemetry, script/log-agent-usage, script/calibration-guard, script/emit-orchestration, script/warn-skip-hooks, script/telemetry-enabled, script/agent-cost, script/log-review-metrics, script/refactor-flow, script/adr-flow, script/plan-format, script/log-escape, script/log-scan, script/parallel-tests, script/verify-prep, script/verify-log, skill/audit] Removed the skill-use and test-edit telemetry scripts, which no hook runs (the ledger hook writes those rows), and cut the tests that pinned them or that repeated a case another test already pins: 3693 tests become 3584, wall-clock 285s to 220s.
* [Cull the shell, gate, util and prose tests](2026-10-29-cull-the-shell-gate-util-and-prose-tests.md) Deleted tests whose bug another test already catches, merged near-duplicates into tables, and sped up sleeps; no script behavior changed.
* [Cull the code-step tests to their pins](2026-10-29-cull-the-code-step-tests-to-their-pins.md) Deleted code-step tests whose behavior another test already pins, merged near-duplicates into subTest tables, and replaced slow end-to-end parse checks with unit tables; no script behavior changed.
* [Cull duplicate review-loop, fix and gate tests](2026-10-29-cull-duplicate-review-loop-fix-and-gate-tests.md) [script/review-loop-gate, script/review-fix, script/review-commit-gate, script/review-loop-script, script/code-step, script/deferred-push-check, script/handback, script/open-child-gate] The review-loop, fix and gate tests lose duplicate runs and near-copies: like cases become subTest tables, and tests another test already pins are deleted.
* [Drop the Python copy of the agent-model guard](2026-10-29-drop-the-python-copy-of-the-agent-model-guard.md) [script/agent-model-guard, rule/settings-json] settings.json registers one agent-model guard on PreToolUse(Agent), the work package's agent-model-guard.sh. The Python port gates/agent_model_guard.py, its test and its fork fixture are deleted.

### Fixed

* [the full check refuses a scoped command for every caller](2026-10-29-the-full-check-refuses-a-scoped-command-for-every.md) [script/full-check] full_check.py's refusal of a command that names files or tests, or whose scope cannot be read, now runs inside run(), so the review-loop script and other direct callers can no longer count a scoped run as a full check.
* [comment-bloat gate skips files git ignores](2026-10-29-comment-bloat-gate-skips-files-git-ignores.md) [script/comment-bloat-gate] The write-time comment-bloat gate no longer checks files git ignores, so a scratch probe script that names a plan path in a string is not blocked.
* [Each code-step wait returns before Claude Code moves the fork's call to the background](2026-10-29-each-code-step-wait-returns-before-claude-code.md) [script/code-step] A code-step verb that waits on an agent now prints its wait line within 150 seconds (was 570), before Claude Code moves the fork's Bash call to the background at 180 seconds, so the fork reads the line and runs the verb again instead of stalling on an empty background call. The cap still stops a silent agent after about thirty minutes.
* [check_scope reads a run that excludes part of the suite as targeted](2026-10-29-check-scope-reads-a-run-that-excludes-part-of-the.md) [script/full-check, script/check-scope] lib/check_scope reads a test or lint run that leaves files, packages, groups or tags out (cargo --exclude, mypy --exclude, rspec --exclude-pattern, phpunit --exclude-group, bats --negative-filter, manage.py --exclude-tag, pytest --ignore and the like) as targeted, so full_check.py refuses it and the stop gate never counts it as a full check.
* [The stop gate counts a multi-call full check only when each call passed](2026-10-29-the-stop-gate-counts-a-multi-call-full-check-only.md) [script/review-loop-gate] The stop gate counts a shell call of several full_check.py calls only when it printed one result line per call and each is passed.
* [The full check refuses a command whose scope cannot be read](2026-10-29-the-full-check-refuses-a-command-whose-scope.md) [script/full-check, agent/review-loop] full_check.py refuses a command check_scope reads as unresolved with the result not run (unresolved command), and review-loop.md routes that result.
* [check_scope reads a scoped cargo, go, rspec or phpunit run as targeted, so the full check refuses it](2026-10-29-the-full-check-refuses-runs-of-runners-check-scope.md) [script/full-check, script/check-scope] lib/check_scope reads a cargo, go, tsc, mypy, pyright, bats, rspec, phpunit or dotnet run that names a file, a directory, a package or a test, or sets a selector flag, as targeted; full_check.py refuses it as a scoped command, and a whole run stays none for the coder gate.
* [SIGTERM test treats a vanished pid as killed](2026-10-29-sigterm-test-treats-a-vanished-pid-as-killed.md) The process-alive helper in the SIGTERM test returns dead when the pid leaves /proc between the signal check and the stat read.
* [plan hook asks for a re-check after the last Edit while a renumber is in progress](2026-10-29-plan-hook-asks-for-a-re-check-after-the-last-edit.md) [script/code-step, script/plan-format] When every plan parse failure is a kind a renumber passes through (duplicate id, missing section, section without status), the plan hook says the plan may be mid-edit and asks the session to re-check after the last Edit, and to report and stop only if the error is still there. A list with any other kind keeps the report-and-stop message.
* [A reviewer's notes after a None line are no longer findings](2026-10-29-a-reviewer-s-notes-after-a-none-line-are-no-longer.md) [agent/review-loop] The review loop's Fix/Ask/Nit parser reads a section that opens with a none line, such as "None.", as empty, so the reviewer's notes below it no longer reach a coder as issues or the user as asks.
* [resume with task text over an open run stops instead of resuming](2026-10-29-resume-with-task-text-over-an-open-run-stops.md) [skill/code, script/code-step] `code_step.py resume <text>` over an open run with no coder waiting for an answer now stops on the user's word with resume, restart and abort, instead of rerunning a bare `resume` that went on with the old task and dropped the new one.
* [tick closes a stopped phase after its verification passes](2026-10-29-tick-closes-a-stopped-phase-after-its-verification.md) [script/code-step] tick runs the phase's Automated Verification commands before it marks the phase done, and works on a run dropped by abort.
* [A CI repo runs its declared check with no tests](2026-10-29-a-ci-repo-runs-its-declared-check-with-no-tests.md) [script/full-check, script/review-loop-script, script/handback, script/code-step, agent/review-loop] In a repo whose CLAUDE.md holds `Full suite: CI`, full_check.py runs the `Quality check:` command, and an exit 0 with no runner summary passes as a check-only result, so the /code gate runs there instead of reporting `not run (CI)`.
* [An ask with an empty question asks its change](2026-10-29-an-ask-with-an-empty-question-asks-its-change.md) [script/review-loop-script, script/handback, agent/review-loop] The review loop no longer builds an ask with an empty question unless it has no change either. Packet validation fills an empty ask question from its finding or its change, and drops an ask with none of them under a Dropped asks warning, so one bad ask no longer fails the whole review.
* [A finding on a scoped package path keeps its at sign](2026-10-29-a-finding-on-a-scoped-package-path-keeps-its-at-sign.md) [script/review-loop-script, script/script-utils] The review loop reads a finding's file:line with the same path regex as the hand-back, so a finding on a path like @scope/pkg/file.ts keeps its @ and routes and matches by its real path.
* [A blocker left over at the review cap still blocks the commit](2026-10-29-a-nit-left-at-the-review-cap-gets-one-fix-and-a.md) [agent/review-loop] The review hand-back hook refuses a converged or deferred packet whose leftovers hold a blocker, or whose full check failed or hit a setup fault, so neither can clear the commit gate.
* [Coder gate runs __tests__ files when npm test wraps jest](2026-10-29-coder-gate-runs-tests-files-when-npm-test-wraps.md) [script/code-step, script/coder-gate] A package with no jest or vitest dependency whose test script names jest or react-scripts now gets the jest test-file rule, so a coder-created __tests__ file is in the derived npm test command.
* [A nested bullet under a review ask stays in that ask](2026-10-29-a-nested-bullet-under-a-review-ask-stays-in-that.md) [agent/review-loop] The review loop's Fix/Ask/Nit parser starts an item only at a marker as shallow as the section's first marker, so one ask with nested bullets reaches the user as one ask.
* [One table of start flags, so a quoted --headless start splits](2026-10-29-one-table-of-start-flags-so-a-quoted-headless.md) [skill/code] The /code start flags now come from one table in code_step_start_args.py; a start string that opens with --headless is split into words instead of exiting on an unknown flag.
* [A coder gate runs every test file the coder creates when the phase names none](2026-10-29-a-coder-gate-runs-every-test-file-the-coder.md) [script/code-step, script/coder-gate] The derived coder-gate test command for a phase that names no test file now runs every changed file that `is_runnable_test_file` counts as a test (foo.spec.js, foo.test.mts, __tests__/foo.jsx under jest, test_foo.py), through a new `{tests}` placeholder, in place of a fixed suffix list that missed them.
* [The stop gate counts only a passed full check result](2026-10-29-the-stop-gate-counts-only-a-passed-full-check.md) [script/review-loop-gate, script/full-check, agent/review-loop] The review-loop stop gate reads full_check.py's result line instead of the command text, so a failed, unverified or bare-runner check no longer lets the loop stop, and full_check.py refuses a command scoped to files or tests.
* [A text review ask ending in a colon keeps its bullets as one ask](2026-10-29-a-text-review-ask-ending-in-a-colon-keeps-its.md) [script/handback, script/code-step] A plain-text ask whose text ends in a colon takes the plain-text bullets after it, so one finding with sub-points is one ask with one outcome word in place of one ask per bullet.
* [The criteria dry run judges each item as verify does](2026-10-29-the-criteria-dry-run-judges-each-item-as-verify.md) [script/code-step, script/criteria-dry-run] The plan-criteria dry run and /code's verification now take their verdict from one function in lib/criteria_verdict.py. Before, the dry run read only a negated search (`! rg`, `! grep`, `! git grep`) as a ban, while verification also read a plain rg, grep or git grep line as a ban unless its text says presence, let ban wording win, and judged a pipe form by its output, so a plan item could read GREEN in the dry run and fail at verify.
* [A multi-line ask stays one ruled-asks entry and indents under its number](2026-10-29-a-multi-line-ask-stays-one-ruled-asks-entry-and.md) [script/code-step, script/review-fix] A ruled ask whose text spans lines folds onto one ruled-asks line with its outcome, and the ask listings indent a multi-line ask's later lines under its number.
* [A code phase stops when its full check shows no test run](2026-10-29-a-code-phase-stops-when-its-full-check-ran-no.md) [script/code-step] A /code phase whose review converged with the full check unverified (exit 0, no runner summary) now stops with the reason check-unverified, names the check command, and asks for a fix before review-again: a Quality check line in the repo's CLAUDE.md when it has none, else a check that prints its runner summary or a SUMMARY_LINES entry for the runner's format. Before, such a phase finished as if verified, although the check did not show that any test ran.
* [review gate runs the listed scoped tests and keeps the full output](2026-10-29-review-gate-runs-the-listed-scoped-tests-and-keeps-the-full-output.md) [script/code-step-gates, script/coder-gate, script/review-loop-script, script/check-output, script/full-check, script/shell-command, script/test-run-output, skill/code, agent/review-loop] The gate now takes the plan's listed test commands behind env, nice, timeout and taskset, `nextest` counts as a test run, the full output goes to scoped-tests.log in the loop's script folder, and the packet names each failing test and the log while the blocker quotes each test's error text, panic messages included. A panic line compares equal across runs whatever its thread id, line and column. /code's fork brief also says every report goes back through the hand-back. Before, a plan that listed its tests behind wrappers (`nice -n 19 env CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=4 cargo nextest run ...`) got a gate of derived `cargo clippy` and `cargo test --tests`, every target in the crate: the test-word list lacked `nextest` and the cargo check did not peel the wrappers. The review loop's scoped-test step also kept only an output tail with no cargo or nextest failure lines, so the packet could not name the failing test.
* [Refuse a non-numeric int field before the ledger](2026-10-29-refuse-a-non-numeric-int-field-before-the-ledger.md) [script/log-review-finding, script/log-escape, agent/review-loop] log-review-finding and log-escape refuse an int field that is not a whole number, naming the pair, before any row is written. review-loop writes each logger call with literal key=value arguments, one call per row.
* [review-commit-gate catches a probe that splits the commit words](2026-10-29-review-commit-gate-catches-a-probe-that-splits-the-commit-words.md) [script/review-commit-gate, agent/code-reviewer] The gate matches the git-commit text patterns again with quoted-string joins removed, so a dirty session's probe that builds the commit text from pieces is denied. The code-reviewer brief says a blocked command is reported, never run in another form.
* [An untitled re-report of a fixed finding at the same line now matches it](2026-10-29-an-untitled-re-report-at-the-same-line-reopens-a.md) [script/review-loop-script] Two findings now match on a near title only when both have a title, and on the same file and line otherwise. Before, when a plan-change round re-reported a fixed finding without a title, the loop matched it only against untitled fixed findings, so a titled finding at the same file and line stayed in fixed while its re-report stayed open.
* [review-commit-gate lets a probe that mentions the commit words pass](2026-10-29-review-commit-gate-lets-a-probe-that-mentions-the-commit-words-pass.md) [script/review-commit-gate] In a dirty session the gate denies a command when a parsed git call commits, in the command or in a `$( )` or backtick span, when a command it cannot read holds git then commit, or, failing closed, when any simple command is not a safe probe and the text holds the commit words. An echo, printf, grep, rg, cat, head, tail, wc or read-only git probe that prints or searches the words passes. A heredoc whose body holds the words is still denied unless its tag is a probe program's name.
* [quality-check-cap counts a tree-rewriting git call as an edit](2026-10-28-quality-check-cap-counts-a-tree-rewriting-git-call-as-an-edit.md) [script/quality-check-cap] git merge, checkout, switch, reset, pull, rebase, restore, cherry-pick, revert, am, apply, clean, rm and mv now count as edits, like a writing formatter, so a check run after one is not denied as a repeat.
* [git-discipline-gate reads the branch of the -C or cd target](2026-10-28-git-discipline-gate-reads-the-branch-of-the-c-or-cd-target.md) [script/git-discipline-gate] The commit-on-main and worktree-prefix rules now read the branch of the repo each git call runs in: its -C directory, taken relative to the target of an earlier cd in the same command, else to the cwd. A cd after a ( not preceded by $ and a quoted or variable target are not followed.
* [A plan-impact re-dispatch carries the stopped round's open findings](2026-10-28-a-plan-impact-re-dispatch-carries-the-stopped.md) [script/review-fix, script/handback, script/review-loop-script, script/code-step, agent/review-loop] After a plan-impact ruling, the re-dispatch lines now list the stopped round's fix findings and asks under carried-findings, the scripted loop puts the round's unapplied fixes in findings_remaining, and review-loop accounts for every carried line in its packet. Before, the re-dispatch carried only the ruling and the counters, so those findings and asks were lost and the next packet looked complete.
* [Failed verification saves its full output and quotes each test error](2026-10-28-failed-verification-saves-its-full-output-and.md) [script/code-step] When /code's Automated Verification fails, the stop now writes the full output of each failed command to verification-output.txt in the run folder, names that path, and quotes each failing test's error text, bounded, or the output's tail when some failing test has no error text after it. Before, the stop report kept only the failing test names and the last 400 characters, so the panic text and assertion diffs were lost and a later /debug could not see the original failure.
* [A code resume at a verification stop is refused before its fork starts](2026-10-28-a-code-resume-at-a-failed-verification-stop-is.md) [script/code-step] A PreToolUse hook on Skill denies `/code`, `/code resume` and `/code continue` while the open run is stopped at its Automated Verification (a command failed, or an item could not be run), and names the step the main session runs: fix the cause, then invoke `/code verify`.
* [A reviewer killed with no tool-use id no longer blocks the hand-back](2026-10-28-a-reviewer-killed-with-no-tool-use-id-no-longer.md) [script/review-loop-gate, script/handback] The loop transcript reader closes a background agent launch on a task notification that names the agent by its task id, so a reviewer the rate limit killed stops counting as pending and the review loop can hand back.
* [The scripted-edit trace strips comments before it reads a literal](2026-10-28-the-scripted-edit-trace-strips-comments-before-it.md) [script/shell-write-gate] shell-write-gate now strips # comments, following quote state, before any tracing, and splits a dict literal at its top-level colon, so a read-only loop over .items() that writes elsewhere is no longer denied. Before, a ')' or a quote inside a # comment in a list or dict literal cut the trace short, so a write to a tracked file passed.
* [Stop hook checks a staged claim against the index](2026-10-28-stop-hook-checks-a-staged-claim-against-the-index.md) [script/staged-claim-gate] A new Stop and SubagentStop hook, staged_claim_gate.py, reads the final message. When a sentence says files are staged, it checks git diff --cached in the repo the sentence names, else the session cwd's repo, and blocks the stop when the index is empty or misses a file the sentence names. Before, a main session could tell the user files were staged without checking, so the user could commit a partial change.
* [shell-write-gate follows names to the file a script writes](2026-10-28-shell-write-gate-follows-names-to-the-file-a.md) [script/shell-write-gate] The gate now follows the written target's names through assignments, for loops and function calls, joins path literals, and its deny text says to keep scratch scripts in the scratchpad. Before, it denied only a script whose write statement named a tracked file as a literal, so an edit script that named its target through a variable, an edit list or dict looped over, a helper's parameter, a joined path, or a method `.open(` got through and the edits skipped the Write/Edit hooks.
* [A coder runs a changed test file through the sharding runner](2026-10-28-a-coder-runs-a-changed-test-file-through-the-sharding.md) [rule/toolkit-script-rules] The toolkit script rules now tell a coder to run a changed test file through tests/parallel_tests.py, which splits test_code_step.py into four processes, so the file finishes inside one 600 s tool call.
* [A cap-reached with an open class routes the next run to the last fix diff](2026-10-28-a-cap-reached-with-an-open-class-routes-the-next.md) [script/review-fix] When a capped review run's class-closure receipt says a class is still open, review_fix.py prints a scoped review of the files the run's fixes touched as the next run and no longer offers a full rerun.
* [Push note drops deferred findings fixed in a later round](2026-10-28-push-note-drops-deferred-findings-fixed-in-a-later.md) [script/deferred-push-check] The pre-push deferred-findings note leaves out a deferred bug finding when a later round fixed a row at the same session, branch, file and line.
* [A closing phase passes run notes to the skill it invokes](2026-10-28-a-closing-phase-passes-run-notes-to-the-skill-it.md) [script/code-step] `code_step.py start <plan> --phase <closing phase> <text>` now hands the text to the closing skill as run notes, and a resume keeps them, where it used to stop and start nothing.
* [The review loggers run in the reviewed repo and log the scoped reviewer's deferrals](2026-10-28-the-review-loggers-run-in-the-reviewed-repo-and.md) [script/log-review-finding, script/log-review-metrics, agent/review-loop, shared/finding-log] log-review-finding and log-review-metrics take root=<path> and run there, so a review loop working on a sibling worktree logs against that worktree, and the cap exit's scoped reviewer defers its fix findings as source=scoped instead of being refused.
* [A review-loop dispatch from a lane subagent is refused](2026-10-28-a-review-loop-dispatch-from-a-lane-subagent-is.md) [script/review-loop-gate] The dispatch gate now refuses a review-loop dispatched by a subagent at once and names the main-session route, except from the /code fork. Before, a review-loop that a subagent dispatched ended with no hand-back twice in a row.
* [The quality cap's cut-output deny no longer rebuilds the command](2026-10-28-the-quality-cap-s-cut-output-deny-no-longer.md) [script/quality-check-cap] The deny after a check whose output went through tail, head or grep rebuilt the command from its split steps and could cut it inside a $( ) substitution; it now names the redirect form with a <check> placeholder.
* [code_step's gone-review-script stop names the pid, the agent and the end of the script log](2026-10-28-code-step-s-gone-review-script-stop-names-the-pid.md) [script/code-step] When the pid probe reads the review script as gone, the stop text names the pid, the agent whose hand-back is missing and the last lines of the script log.
* [The Django gate test command runs with --noinput](2026-10-28-the-django-gate-test-command-runs-with-noinput.md) [script/code-step] A derived `manage.py test` gate command now carries --noinput unless the listed command already has --noinput or --no-input. Before, it asked before deleting a leftover test database, hit EOF and ran no tests, so the coder used up its gate denials on a green change.
* [A review ask's bullets stay inside the ask they follow](2026-10-28-a-review-ask-s-bullets-stay-inside-the-ask-they.md) [script/handback, script/code-step] In a multi-line ask (a mapping lead, then plain-text bullets at the same indent) the bullets now join the lead ask's question, and the /code asks-done refusal names how many outcomes it expects. Before, each bullet parsed as its own ask, so asks-done wanted an outcome for each.
* [asks-done logs the outcome of an ask that names no file](2026-10-28-asks-done-logs-the-outcome-of-an-ask-that-names-no.md) [script/review-fix] An ask whose file_line is `unlocated` now logs its ask row and outcome row, because the row carries no line. Before, it sent `line=0` to the finding writer, which refuses a line on an unlocated finding, so both rows were lost.
* [The review loop runs the autofix formatters before a full-check failure blocks](2026-10-28-the-review-loop-runs-the-autofix-formatters-before.md) [agent/review-loop] The review loop runs the autofix formatters on touched files and reruns a failing full check once.
* [The review loop reports a full-check failure the diff did not cause as pre-existing](2026-10-28-the-review-loop-reports-a-full-check-failure-the.md) [agent/review-loop] When the full check fails, the review loop reruns it on HEAD without the diff; a failure whose every failing line also fails there is reported as pre-existing, spends no repair coder and does not block.
* [code resume says a phase split away from the plan is stale at a plan-fix stop](2026-10-28-code-resume-says-a-phase-split-away-from-the-plan.md) [script/code-step] A stop for a verification or plan-format fix no longer hides that the stopped phase id left the plan.
* [code resume waits on a live review script and names the changed phase text](2026-10-28-code-resume-waits-on-a-live-review-script-and.md) [script/code-step] resume no longer calls a run stale while its review script is alive, and a stale question quotes the phase lines that changed.
* [A code run's own coder and review-loop plan edits no longer make it stale](2026-10-28-a-code-run-s-own-coder-and-review-loop-plan-edits.md) [script/code-step] Taking the hand-back of the run's own coder or review-loop re-reads the phase text from the plan, and `resume` skips the stale check when that hand-back is waiting, so the run's own edits under the same phase heading never ask for `start --restart`. A plan edit made after the hand-back was taken, or while the coder is still out, is still stale.
* [code-step: a restart refuses while the capped coder has not handed back](2026-10-28-code-step-a-restart-refuses-while-the-capped-coder.md) [script/code-step] After the coder wait cap, `start --restart` now refuses and names the coder to stop, and `--coder-stopped` passes once it is stopped. Before, it dispatched a new coder while the silent one could still be editing the same tree.
* [shell-write-gate: /var/tmp counts as a temp dir](2026-10-28-shell-write-gate-var-tmp-counts-as-a-temp-dir.md) [script/shell-write-gate] /var/tmp now always counts as a temp dir, and a redirect onto a git-tracked file there still denies. Before, a coder's redirect into a new log under /var/tmp was denied as a new file outside a temp dir unless $TMPDIR named /var/tmp.
* [A review fix on a plan line a recorded ruling covers becomes an ask](2026-10-28-a-review-fix-on-a-ruled-plan-line-becomes-an-ask.md) [script/review-loop] The scripted review loop reads the plan's Plan Deviations and Constraints sections and turns a fix finding on a ruled plan line into an ask instead of sending it to the coder.
* [A phase commit subject names its phase](2026-10-28-a-phase-commit-subject-names-its-phase.md) [script/code-step] A plan run's commit subject built from the coder summary or the title ends with (phase <id>), or (plan <folder>) with no phase; a plan-named Commit line and planless runs are unchanged.
* [A finding the coder made no change for is not listed as fixed](2026-10-28-a-finding-the-coder-made-no-change-for-is-not-listed-as-fixed.md) [script/review-loop-script] When a coder pass, full-check repair or class-closure pass changes no file, its findings go to skipped_fp with the reason the coder made no change, not to fixed.
* [The review loop skips findings on files absent from the tree](2026-10-28-the-review-loop-skips-findings-on-files-absent-from-the-tree.md) [script/review-loop-script] A reviewer finding whose file:line names a file neither on disk nor listed by git goes to skipped_fp and never reaches the coder; a plan-change ask still stops the loop.
* [The unreviewed-fix section says no reviewer read the last fixes and that review-again is not advised](2026-10-28-the-unreviewed-fix-section-advises-against-review-again.md) [script/handback, script/review-fix, script/code-step] The hand-back's last-fix section states plainly that no reviewer read the loop's last fixes, names their files, and says a review-again ends the same way.
* [The review loop reruns the scoped tests after a fix no full check verified](2026-10-28-the-review-loop-reruns-the-scoped-tests-after-an-unchecked-fix.md) [script/review-loop-script, script/coder-gate, script/handback, agent/review-loop] A converged review loop whose last coder pass no passed full check followed reruns the run's scoped test commands, reports the result as scoped_tests in the hand-back, and stops critical-blocker when one fails.
* [code_step runs one verb at a time on a run](2026-10-28-code-step-runs-one-verb-at-a-time-on-a-run.md) [script/code-step] A second code_step verb started while another runs on the same run stops with the holder's pid and changes nothing; abort still runs.
* [verify-prep hands plan-verifier its run rules](2026-10-28-verify-prep-hands-plan-verifier-its-run-rules.md) [script/verify-prep] verify-prep's payload, the only dispatch prompt plan-verifier gets, now ends with four run rules: run the plan's commands as written and beyond them only a covering test's file, never run a self-chosen test that touches files outside the checkout (user config or sibling repos), run in the foreground and leave no process, and delete, move, kill or create nothing but a Manual Verification checkbox line. Before, the payload carried no run rules, and at branch end plan-verifier ran every test file it could find, including one that snapshots the real ~/.claude, wrote log files into a sibling checkout and deleted them, and left a background test run going.
* [code-step: start over a closable run offers verify first](2026-10-28-code-step-start-over-a-closable-run-offers-verify.md) [script/code-step] start over an open run that verify may close now names verify first, and a bare start reruns verify. Before, the refusal offered only resume, status or restart.
* [code-step: a restart over passing checks closes the phase without a coder](2026-10-28-code-step-a-restart-over-passing-checks-closes-the.md) [script/code-step] start --restart over a reviewed, unfinished phase now runs the phase's Automated Verification first and closes the phase when every check passes. Before, it dispatched a fresh coder even when the code was done.
* [code-step: verify closes a phase whose review converged](2026-10-28-code-step-verify-closes-a-phase-whose-review.md) [script/code-step] verify now also runs whenever the phase's review converged and no coder works on it, so the runner records the checks. Before, it ran only after a failed Automated Verification or a plan-format stop.
* [code-step: a failed Automated Verification keeps the failing test names](2026-10-28-code-step-a-failed-automated-verification-keeps.md) [script/code-step] An Automated Verification stop now lists the failing-test lines of the whole output above the last 400 characters. Before, it showed only those last 400 characters of a failed command, so the failing test names were lost.
* [log-review-finding drops a line on an unlocated finding and logs it](2026-10-28-log-review-finding-drops-a-line-on-an-unlocated.md) [script/log-review-finding] log-review-finding now drops the line with a warning on stderr and logs the row with no file and no line when it gets `file=unlocated` with a `line=`. Before, it exited and logged no row.
* [herdr-worktree --fork fails loudly when the fork never starts](2026-10-28-herdr-worktree-fork-fails-loudly-when-the-fork-never-starts.md) [script/herdr-worktree, script/herdr-dev] herdr-dev waits for the new pane's shell prompt and clears the input line before it types the claude command, and keeps the brief file until claude exits cleanly. herdr-worktree --fork then waits for herdr to report a claude agent in that pane; if none shows within the timeout it exits 1 and names the pane and the command to run there.
* [code-step names its state folder once per verb, and the walk's hand-back stub carries a transcript](2026-10-28-code-step-names-its-state-folder-once-per-verb-and.md) [script/code-step] state_dir now asks git for the code-step state folder once per resolved folder, which cuts the termination walk's CPU time by about a sixth. The walk's review-loop hand-back stub now names an empty loop transcript, so the hand-back gates run instead of printing a KeyError. Before, it asked git about 14 times per verb.
* [spec-questions repairs whole questions, and a check holds one question per line](2026-10-28-spec-questions-repairs-whole-questions-and-a-check-holds-the-shape.md) [agent/spec-questions, agent/goal-blind-researcher, script/questions-check] A new questions_check.py fails a questions file with a clause cut short before `?`, two questions on one line, a wrapped question or a numbering gap; spec-questions runs it after every write, and goal-blind-researcher applies the leak check's own rewrites after two cycles instead of returning UNRESOLVED.
* [The full check reads the dotfiles suite's total line as its summary](2026-10-28-the-full-check-reads-the-dotfiles-suite-s-total.md) [script/full-check] runner_summaries reads the dotfiles suite runner's total line, so a passing dotfiles full check reads passed, not unverified, and a total with failed files reads failed.
* [Plan checks refuse a command that hands a shell its code](2026-10-28-plan-checks-refuse-a-command-that-hands-a-shell.md) [script/code-step, shared/plan-format, skill/eng-spec] The plan check now treats a shell run with `-c` (sh, bash, zsh, dash, ksh, any flag cluster with c) as no verification command: the plan stops at write time with a message to write the command plainly or put the pipeline in an executable repo script. A shell that runs a script file still passes. The plan format says the same. Before, an eng-spec plan could write an Automated Verification command as `sh -c '...'`; the check accepted it because `sh` is a program on PATH, and the shell hook then blocked the command when /code ran it.
* [herdr-phase-change sends the next phase's prompt only after /clear takes effect](2026-10-28-herdr-phase-change-sends-the-next-phase-s-prompt.md) [script/herdr-phase-change, rule/orchestration] A new herdr-phase-change script sends /clear, waits for herdr to report a new session id for the pane, and only then sends the prompt. If the id does not change in time it sends nothing more and exits 1. The orchestration rules name the script for every phase change. Before, an orchestrator sent a worker /clear and then /code as two herdr agent prompt calls with a wait between them. The worker was already done, so the wait returned at once, and the pane got one input, /clear/code ..., which ran on the full eng-spec context.
* [The comment-bloat gate finds plan paths and provenance inside strings](2026-10-28-comment-bloat-gate-finds-plan-paths-and-provenance-inside-strings.md) [script/comment-bloat-gate] The `docs/plans/`, `per the <source>` and `written by the <author>` markers search the raw line again, so an error or log string that names one blocks; the phase, AC and other markers still skip string text.
* [git-discipline-gate reads git calls in command position and blocks autostash](2026-10-28-git-discipline-gate-reads-git-calls-and-blocks-autostash.md) [script/git-discipline-gate] The gate parses each git call past git's own options and wrapper words, blocks stash in every form but list and show, blocks autostash on pull, rebase and merge, and lets git words inside heredocs, quotes and comments pass.
* [test-reviewer reads files in place, and the review packet names each blocked agent](2026-10-28-test-reviewer-reads-files-in-place-and-the-review-packet-names.md) [agent/test-reviewer, agent/review-loop, script/handback] test-reviewer never copies the tree into a scratchpad and reports a refused call on a `Blocked:` line; review-loop carries it in a `blocked_agents` packet field, which handback renders under its own heading.
* [Pin merge-resolution routes and fix the missing-module rule](2026-10-28-pin-merge-resolution-routes-and-fix-the-missing.md) [script/full-check, script/code-step, agent/review-loop] Two tests pin merge resolutions that had none (a tool fault outranks the blocker-with-asks route; an environment gap outranks a setup fault), and the review-loop's missing-module rule now excludes declared dependencies.
* [A critical-blocker stop with asks goes through asks-done](2026-10-28-a-critical-blocker-stop-with-asks-goes-through.md) [script/code-step, script/handback] A /code run stopped by a critical blocker that carries asks now takes the user's rulings through asks-done and carries the blockers into one more review, as a cap-reached stop with asks already does.
* [asks-done names the directory it looked in](2026-10-28-asks-done-names-the-directory-it-looked-in.md) [script/review-fix] When asks-done finds no packet, the refusal names the review-fix state directory it looked in and the directory it ran from, so a call from another repo is told to run there.
* [Code fork hands questions back instead of messaging](2026-10-28-code-fork-hands-questions-back-instead-of.md) [skill/code] A /code fork's question reaches the session that ran /code through question.md in the hand-back and is never sent by message, even when the task names a session to ask.
* [Review loop gate reads the CI-only rule from the reviewed repo](2026-10-28-review-loop-gate-reads-the-ci-only-rule-from-the.md) [script/review-loop-gate, script/handback] The review-loop stop gate and hand-back gate look for the Full suite: CI line in the repo the loop reviewed, not only in the hook cwd.
* [Review loop reads the last JSON object and a coder stop names its cause](2026-10-28-review-loop-reads-the-last-json-object-and-a-coder-stop-names-its-cause.md) [script/review-loop-script, script/code-step] The review loop script reads its disposition, check-finder and closure replies from the last JSON object that holds the wanted key, so braces in prose or a nested object no longer break the read. A coder stop names its cause: no reviewable change, or a recommendation of /eng-spec. The termination walk also covers the review loop run as a detached script.
* [Resume picks the right route from a stopped or stale code run](2026-10-28-resume-picks-the-right-route-from-a-stopped-or.md) [script/code-step, agent/review-loop] /code resume takes a launched coder's report, refuses --help and dash answers, offers review-again after a blocker or setup fault, lists the reviewer's asks apart from the coder's notes, and flags a phase the plan changed.
* [The full check reports its runner summary and its own file changes, and calls a version mismatch a setup fault](2026-10-28-the-full-check-reports-its-runner-summary-undoes.md) [script/full-check, script/review-loop-script, script/handback, script/code-step, agent/review-loop] full_check.py quotes the test runner's own summary line and calls an exit 0 with none `unverified`; it names tracked files its command rewrote and files it created, so neither counts as coder work or lands in /code's commit; a package-manager version mismatch is a setup fault; the review loop calls its logger by full path and never writes rows to a file of its own.
* [shell-write-gate denies an untracked script or inline code that writes a tracked file](2026-10-28-shell-write-gate-denies-an-untracked-script-or.md) [script/shell-write-gate, skill/coder-core, agent/review-loop] The gate now denies an interpreter run whose inline code or untracked script opens a file for writing and names a git-tracked file, and the coder and review-loop prompts say a blocked file write is redone with Edit or Write only. Before, after the gate denied a sed -i, a coder redid the edit with a Python script, which skips the Write/Edit hooks just the same.
* [The hand-back gate finds a subfolder manage.py and names a missing test path as a command error](2026-10-28-the-hand-back-gate-finds-a-subfolder-manage-py-and-names.md) [script/code-step, script/coder-gate] The gate builds `manage.py test` from a manage.py in a subfolder with labels from that folder, and a gate command that stops on a path that does not exist is a command error that never denies or spends the cap, flagged apart from the cap.
* [A headless /code run commits and goes on where a phase waits for sign-off](2026-10-28-a-headless-code-run-commits-and-goes-on-where-a-phase-waits-for-sign-off.md) [script/code-step] `code_step.py start --headless` turns every block B sign-off stop into a block A commit and auto-advance, and carries the flag to each next phase and to a restart; the phase-end block text moves to code_step_phase_end.py.
* [review_fix plan-impact ask falls back to plain text when AskUserQuestion is missing](2026-10-28-review-fix-plan-impact-ask-falls-back-to-plain.md) [script/review-fix, skill/review, skill/fix] The plan-impact action now tells the session to ask in plain text with numbered options and decide on the answer when AskUserQuestion is missing. Before, it said to call AskUserQuestion with no fallback.
* [review_fix reports a pending dispatch before a code run's ownership](2026-10-28-review-fix-reports-a-pending-dispatch-before-a.md) [script/review-fix] packet now reports a pending standalone review-loop dispatch before it names a /code run as the owner of the session's hand-backs. Before, it named the run as owner when the stored hand-back was the run's but a newer dispatch had not handed back yet.
* [quality-check-cap skips a check whose redirect failed and dates a run at its start](2026-10-28-quality-check-cap-skips-a-check-whose-redirect.md) [script/quality-check-cap] A check whose output redirect the shell could not open is no longer recorded, and a run record keeps the run's start. Before, the cap recorded a check that never ran and then denied every rerun of it, and it dated a run at its end, so an edit made while the check ran did not count.
* [A planless /code run edits the plan docs an adopt needs and says it is not committed](2026-10-28-a-planless-code-run-edits-the-plan-docs-an-adopt-needs.md) [script/code-step] After `decide adopt` in a planless run, code-step dispatches a coder to rewrite the branch's plan docs and add a Plan Deviations entry, and the review then covers that edit; the planless end says nothing is committed.
* [Review loop cannot hand back while its background reviewer runs](2026-10-28-review-loop-cannot-hand-back-while-its-background-reviewer-runs.md) [script/handback] The handback hook denies a review-loop hand-back while the loop's own transcript shows a background agent or shell that has not reported back, so the loop waits and its stop routes to wait-for-loop.
* [hand-back gate runs a Django repo's own test runner when the plan lists none](2026-10-28-hand-back-gate-runs-a-django-repo-s-own-test.md) [script/coder-gate, script/code-step] With no usable test command in the plan, the hand-back gate now runs manage.py test on the changed test modules in a Django repo, a Django settings error under pytest is a setup fault, and a manage.py test run that ran no test is no pass. Before, it ran bare pytest in a Django repo with no pytest-django settings, so collection failed on missing settings and the gate spent its denials on a non-code error.
* [The review commit gate sees a commit behind a git option joined to a substitution](2026-10-28-the-review-commit-gate-sees-a-commit-behind-a-joined.md) [script/review-commit-gate] is_commit_command also reads the command with each substitution span shrunk, so `git -p""$(cat <<'EOF' ...)"" commit` and `git -C$(echo a b) commit` count as commits and a dirty session is denied.
* [Plan check reads only a standalone upper-case AC<n> as a reference](2026-10-28-plan-check-reads-only-a-standalone-upper-case-ac-n-as-a-reference.md) [script/plan-format] AC_REFERENCE matches `AC` case-sensitively and counts `_` as a word character, so `test_ac1_x`, `foo_AC2` and `ac3-evidence.md` no longer fail plan check as unknown AC ids.
* [The concentration gate skips docs and reads a folded gate item](2026-10-28-the-concentration-gate-skips-docs-and-reads-a-folded.md) [script/code-step, skill/code] The refactor phase's concentration gate no longer counts files under a docs/ folder, and skill-done writes the simplify record under a Manual Verification item that names the gate instead of asking for the exact criterion line.
* [A plain bullet under Automated Verification is read as an open check](2026-10-28-a-plain-bullet-under-automated-verification-is-read-as-an-open-check.md) [script/plan-format, script/code-step] A top-level list item under `#### Automated Verification` that is not a checkbox is read as an open `- [ ]` item, and plan check prints a file:line warning for it, instead of the item being skipped unrun.
* [/code resume with a task and no open run starts it](2026-10-28-code-resume-with-a-task-and-no-open-run-starts-it.md) [script/code-step] code_step.py resume given text with no run open hands the text to start, so a task file or task text sent with no verb starts a run instead of a refusal that pointed at a bare resume.
* [The hand-back hook denies a packet that names the plan file](2026-10-28-the-hand-back-hook-denies-a-packet-that-names-the-plan-file.md) [script/handback, script/review-loop-gate, agent/review-loop] A review-loop packet whose files_touched names the plan file is denied before delivery, and the stop gate skips its plan check once a hand-back was delivered.
* [The coder gate and the review loop's full check run the repo's own test command](2026-10-27-the-coder-gate-and-the-review-loop-s-full-check.md) [script/code-step, script/coder-gate, script/review-loop-script, script/handback, script/review-fix, agent/review-loop, skill/coder-core] The hand-back gate runs the plan phase's listed test commands verbatim instead of a bare pytest, vitest or jest it builds itself; a run that found no test or no package manifest is a setup fault, not a code failure; the full check stops as setup-fault with no coder repair; failure text keeps the failing test's name; a round-two prompt goes on stdin.
* [The review commit gate stops misreading merges, peer messages and closed loops](2026-10-27-the-review-commit-gate-scopes-coder-work-to-its.md) [script/review-commit-gate] The review commit gate credits a converged review-loop hand-back however the run closed, keeps a [no-review] order through peer messages, summaries and shell echoes, and stops counting commit-tree; it still denies a commit in any repo while coder work is unreviewed.
* [code start runs in the checkout the task names and takes its arguments as given](2026-10-27-code-start-runs-in-the-checkout-the-task-names-and.md) [script/code-step, skill/code] /code start takes --repo or a Repo: line at the top of the task file and runs in that checkout, so a run handed only a task file no longer lands in the session's cwd and hits another repo's open run. A --task brief passed as one string reaches a planless run, --phase with run notes uses the saved plan, plan --help prints usage, and say.md keeps one Implemented block.
* [The full check runs under the repo's pinned Python, and a missing module is an environment gap](2026-10-27-the-full-check-runs-under-the-repos-pinned-python.md) [script/full-check, script/review-loop-script, agent/review-loop] full_check.py puts the pyenv shims first on PATH in a repo with a .python-version file, and a check that fails on a missing module the repo declares as a dependency reports an environment gap that never stops the phase.
* [A too-long reviewer prompt is a tool fault with a retry](2026-10-27-a-too-long-reviewer-prompt-is-a-tool-fault-with-a-retry.md) [script/review-loop, script/code-step] The review loop script passes the round-one fix diff as a file path, marks a crashed run `tool_fault`, and /code stops on it with a review-again route instead of a critical blocker.
* [A live review loop script past the wait cap keeps the wait going](2026-10-27-a-live-review-loop-script-past-the-wait-cap.md) [script/code-step] /code counts a running review loop script's wait cap from its last calls.jsonl or full-check.log write, and its cap stop says the script is still running, not that it died.
* [A coder escalates to /eng-spec only through a marker line](2026-10-27-a-coder-escalates-to-eng-spec-only-through-a-marker.md) [script/code-step, skill/coder-core] code_step stops a run for /eng-spec only on a `RECOMMEND: eng-spec` line, so a coder report that says no /eng-spec is needed goes on to review.
* [A git grep presence check passes on a hit](2026-10-27-a-git-grep-presence-check-passes-on-a-hit.md) [script/code-step] /code verify reads a git grep line the way it reads an rg or grep line: a ban unless its text says it checks presence, so a presence check that finds its match passes.
* [code-step termination test holds one repo copy on disk at a time](2026-10-27-code-step-termination-test-holds-one-repo-copy-on.md) [script/code-step] The termination walk now keeps a compressed snapshot and its saved state in memory for each node; a copy is unpacked only to step a child or check its commands, and is removed when that step ends. Before, it kept an unpacked repo copy per visited node under /tmp and left them behind when it stopped.
* [A false-clean stop names review-again, and review-again recovers it in place](2026-10-27-a-false-clean-stop-names-review-again-and-review-again.md) [script/code-step] When the hand-back record refuses the clean mark, code_step saves the run as stopped with reason false-clean and tells the session to invoke Skill code with `review-again`, which now accepts that stop and runs one more review on the same diff.
* [A /code phase is marked done only after the review loop is allowed to stop](2026-10-27-a-review-hand-back-whose-stop-the-gate-blocks-no.md) [script/code-step] code_step counts a review-loop agent's hand-back only once the review-loop gate lets the loop stop after it, so `resume` no longer marks a phase done on a hand-back the gate then sent back to work.
* [Review metrics and run rows refuse a result outside the verdicts, and a bare word](2026-10-27-review-metrics-and-run-rows-refuse-a-result-outside.md) [script/log-review-metrics, script/log-review-finding, script/refactor-flow, agent/review-loop, shared/finding-log] log-review-metrics and log-review-finding take result= only from a fixed set and exit 1 on any other value or on an arg with no `=`; a metrics row needs a result; the loop's instructions name the underscore tokens.
* [A review-loop hand-back that ends on a fix passes and names the fix files, and a no-reviewer re-dispatch keeps the round count](2026-10-27-review-loop-reviews-its-last-fix-and-a-re-dispatch.md) [script/handback, script/review-fix, script/code-step, script/review-loop-script, skill/review, skill/fix] The hand-back hook and the review gate accept a clean hand-back whose last step is a coder after a reviewer, review_fix.py packet lists that fix's files in the user text, and a stop-no-reviewer re-dispatch carries iter= and stops on a second miss in a row.
* [Review loop records: crashed coders, metrics rows, run rows and test ledger writes come out right](2026-10-27-review-loop-records-crashed-coders-metrics-rows.md) [script/review-loop-script, script/log-review-metrics, script/review-loop-gate, script/parallel-tests, agent/review-loop, skill/coder-core] A coder that dies mid-fix reports the files it changed, the metrics logger refuses a row it would store wrong, the stop hook blocks a stale or short metrics line and an unlogged nit and writes run rows for the reviewed repo, and no test can write to the real ledger.
* [review-loop reviews the repo it was given, not the session's cwd](2026-10-27-review-loop-reviews-the-repo-it-was-given-not-the.md) [agent/review-loop, skill/review, skill/fix] review-loop takes a repo: input, falls back to the first absolute path the prompt names, and runs review-scope with root= so a sibling worktree gets its own diff.
* [The scripted review loop writes one finding row per finding, with the reviewer's class and the coder's outcome](2026-10-27-the-scripted-review-loop-writes-one-finding-row.md) [script/review-loop-script] The scripted review loop's finding rows now carry the class the reviewer tagged, a 1-based iter, the actioned value the coder's report shows, and one stable id per finding, so the watches that read review-findings.jsonl read the loop again instead of its logger.
* [Python hooks start through a launcher that skips the pyenv shim](2026-10-27-python-hooks-start-through-a-launcher-that-skips.md) [rule/settings-json, script/hook-python] Every Python hook in settings.json runs through scripts/tools/hook-python, which finds a real interpreter without starting pyenv, so a tool call no longer waits 1-2 s on a version manager's shim.
* [comment-bloat gate treats the opening line of a multi-line data string as data from the opening quote](2026-10-27-comment-bloat-gate-treats-the-opening-line-of-a.md) [script/comment-bloat-gate] The gate now searches only the text before the opening quote of an assigned or passed multi-line string. Before, it searched the whole opening line.
* [asks-done answers one packet when several wait](2026-10-27-asks-done-answers-one-packet-when-several-wait.md) [script/review-fix] A second packet no longer replaces the first packet's unanswered asks; asks-done takes --packet to pick which packet it answers.
