* [A stop-status packet keeps its asks for asks-done](2026-10-27-a-stop-status-packet-keeps-its-asks-for-asks-done.md) [script/review-fix] A cap-reached or critical-blocker packet that carries ask[] entries now prints and saves them, so asks-done logs their outcomes.
* [A /code run's dispatches name its checkout, and later verbs follow the run from any cwd](2026-10-27-a-code-run-s-dispatches-name-its-checkout-and.md) [script/code-step, skill/code] Every agent code_step.py dispatches is told the run's checkout as an absolute path and to work only there, and every verb after start goes on with the session's open run when the shell stands in another repo.
* [herdr-worktree takes the fork brief as a file, so a worktree session can fork](2026-10-27-herdr-worktree-takes-the-fork-brief-as-a-file-so-a.md) [script/herdr-worktree, rule/orchestration] herdr-worktree --fork takes --prompt-file <path>, and the orchestration rule runs it with literal paths in place of --prompt "$(cat <brief file>)", which Claude Code's worktree guard refuses.
* [code-step hooks now find a /code run in a worktree outside the session's cwd](2026-10-27-code-step-hooks-find-a-code-run-in-a-worktree.md) [script/code-step] Every code-step hook now also reads every repo the session pinned, so a /code run in a worktree gets its launch and hand-back logged. Before, the hooks read only the session's checkout, and resume asked for a second dispatch.
* [Telemetry scripts find the ledger in the cargo bin folder and warn when it is missing](2026-10-27-telemetry-scripts-find-the-ledger-in-the-cargo-bin.md) [script/ledger-write, script/review-fix, script/code-step] The telemetry writers and readers now also look for `ledger` in ${CARGO_HOME:-~/.cargo}/bin; the settings.json hooks run a new `ledger-hook` wrapper. The /review and /code reports say so when no ledger is found. The fallback stays: no hard error. Before, they looked on PATH only, so a hook or Bash call without the login PATH missed the installed ledger and wrote rows to the jsonl fallback, which the ledger's readers never see.
* [The review metrics line counts a fix routed to an ask under ask](2026-10-27-the-review-metrics-line-counts-a-fix-routed-to-an.md) [script/review-loop-script, agent/review-loop] A [design-decision] fix that the review loop sends to the user as an ask now counts under ask on the metrics line, not under fix, in the scripted loop and in the review-loop agent's Step 7 rule.
* [The model-pin hook lets fork dispatches through](2026-10-27-the-model-pin-hook-lets-fork-dispatches-through.md) [script/agent-model-guard] agent_model_guard passes an Agent call with subagent_type fork before its opus, inherit and pin checks, since a fork always runs on the parent's model.
* [Hand-back gate runs Python checks through the repo's runner and does not deny on setup faults](2026-10-27-hand-back-gate-runs-python-checks-through-the-repo.md) [script/code-step, script/coder-gate] The coder hand-back gate builds its pytest and ruff commands from the phase's listed pytest command, else the repo's lock file or virtualenv, and a failure that shows the environment cannot run a check is reported as a setup fault that never denies or counts toward the cap.
* [Scripted review loop records its clean tree for the commit gate](2026-10-27-scripted-review-loop-records-its-clean-tree-for.md) [agent/review-loop, script/review-commit-gate] When the scripted review loop hands back converged or deferred, it records the tree it ended on as reviewed, so the session's commit of that tree passes the commit gate even when the /code run that launched it ended first.
* [Shell gates cover subagents, coder new files and stdin code; quoted redirects stop counting](2026-10-27-shell-gates-cover-subagents-coder-new-files-and.md) [script/shell-write-gate, script/inline-interpreter-hint, script/pipe-shell-check] shell-write-gate now holds subagents and coders to the redirect and in-place rules with no skip comment, denies a coder's new file outside the temp roots, and stops reading a quoted `>` or `2>&1` as a write; the interpreter hint denies code fed on stdin; the pipe-to-shell check ignores a quoted `|` and sees through wrappers.
* [review packet waits on a shell the loop moved to the background](2026-10-27-review-packet-waits-on-a-shell-the-loop-moved-to.md) [script/review-loop-gate, script/review-fix, script/handback, skill/review, skill/fix] The review-loop stop gate counts a shell call moved to the background, by run_in_background or its timeout, as open work until its task notification, so packet prints wait-for-loop, not stop-no-handback.
* [code_step test pins a review-loop hand-back that lands after the wait-cap stop](2026-10-27-code-step-test-pins-a-review-loop-hand-back-that.md) [script/code-step] A test replays the LED-10 run: the fork's SendMessage to a review-loop is queued before the wait-cap stop, the loop hands back after it, and `resume` takes that hand-back instead of asking the user.
* [quality-check-cap allows one rerun redirected to a file after a run cut by tail, head or grep](2026-10-27-quality-check-cap-allows-one-rerun-redirected-to-a.md) [script/quality-check-cap] When a check's last run was piped through tail, head or grep, the cap allows one rerun with its output sent to a file, and the deny names that exact form.
* [A review-loop's cap-exit coder no longer marks its hand-back unreviewed](2026-10-27-a-review-loop-s-cap-exit-coder-no-longer-marks-its.md) [script/handback, agent/review-loop] The hand-back hook demanded a reviewer after a review-loop's last coder, but the loop's own cap exit dispatches none after its round-2 coder, so every loop whose second review filed a fix ended stop-no-reviewer; from round 2 on, one reviewer dispatch by the loop now suffices.
* [branch recap lists companion branches that have no PR](2026-10-26-branch-recap-lists-companion-branches-that-have-no.md) [skill/branch-recap] branch-recap gains a step that checks every other repo the spec names for a PR on its branch, lists a pushed branch with no PR first in a Companion branches section, and starts the Next line with opening it.
* [mutation seed warning names its owner and stays quiet while the run is live](2026-10-26-mutation-seed-warning-names-its-owner-and-stays.md) [agent/mutation-tester, skill/calibrate] The mutation and calibrate lock records its worktree and owner pid; the session-start guard gives a restore command, with an absolute path, only for a stale lock, and a short do-not-restore note for a live one.
* [test-reviewer never mutates the shared tree](2026-10-26-test-reviewer-never-mutates-the-shared-tree.md) [agent/test-reviewer] test-reviewer is told it is read-only and reports a mutation check as a finding instead of running it on the tree its sibling reviewers test.
* [A cancelled spec leaves no research file behind](2026-10-26-a-cancelled-spec-leaves-no-research-file-behind.md) [skill/eng-spec, agent/spec-research] eng-spec's research phase deletes the questions file before it stops the researcher, and spec-research writes nothing when its questions file is gone.
* [Shell statement reader skips heredocs with escaped or hyphenated delimiters](2026-10-26-shell-statement-reader-skips-heredocs-with-escaped.md) [script/wait-loop-gate] The heredoc opener pattern accepts a backslash-escaped delimiter and dots or hyphens in the delimiter, so the follow-mode gate no longer reads such a heredoc's file text as commands.
* [review-fix packet reads a standalone review's hand-back while a code run waits on another agent](2026-10-26-review-fix-packet-reads-a-standalone-review-s-hand.md) [script/review-fix] review_fix packet refuses a hand-back only when it belongs to the agent the open /code run launched, so a standalone /review in the same session gets its fix packet.
* [The comment-bloat gate counts only added comment lines and skips string text](2026-10-26-the-comment-bloat-gate-counts-only-added-comment.md) [script/comment-bloat-gate] An edit that adds no net comment line passes the ratio check, the marker rule ignores text inside string literals, and the deny text keeps a comment the task requires.
* [The stage skill reads the branch diff when every phase is committed](2026-10-26-the-stage-skill-reads-the-branch-diff-when-every.md) [skill/stage] stage.mjs --run on a clean tree classifies the branch diff against its merge-base with the default branch, in report-only mode, instead of finding nothing.
* [Telemetry loggers now print their usage on --help](2026-10-26-telemetry-loggers-print-their-usage-on-help.md) [script/log-escape, script/log-spec-run, script/log-scan, script/log-escape-check, script/ledger-write, script/log-review-finding, script/log-review-metrics, script/log-review-check, script/review-scope] The four loggers and log-escape-check in telemetry/, and the four review scripts, print their header usage block on --help or -h, exit 0 and write no row. Before, `log-escape --help` and `log-spec-run --help` refused the flag as a malformed key=value pair.
* [branch-recap reads the deferred queue through a script that waits out a cache behind](2026-10-26-branch-recap-reads-the-deferred-queue-through-a.md) [skill/branch-recap, script/ledger-deferred] branch-recap Step 2 runs scripts/tools/ledger_deferred.py, which waits the shared 90 s for a ledger that is behind and otherwise prints deferred: not read with the command to run, never an empty queue.
* [A busy ledger read waits about 90 s before it gives up](2026-10-26-a-busy-ledger-read-waits-about-90-s-before-it.md) [script/script-utils, script/verify-common] script_utils.read_ledger retries a ledger read that exits 75 for up to LEDGER_WAIT_SECONDS = 90 (8 tries, 84 s of pauses), and verify_common and the branch-recap deferred read both go through it in place of their own retry loops.
* [parallel_tests kills a test file past its time limit](2026-10-26-parallel-tests-kills-a-test-file-past-its-time.md) [script/parallel-tests] The suite runner kills a test file's process group after 1200 s (TEST_FILE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS) and reports that file as failed by name, so one hung file no longer stalls tests/run.sh.
* [A test run piped into another command is no longer failed as matching no test](2026-10-26-matches-no-test-leaves-a-runner-piped-into-another.md) [script/code-step, script/test-run-output] A test runner whose output feeds a later pipe stage (`cargo test <filter> 2>&1 | rg -q ...`) is judged by its last stage, which owns the output and the exit code, and no longer reads as matching no test.
* [code skill reads say.md and question.md only when present](2026-10-26-code-skill-reads-say-md-and-question-md-only-when.md) [skill/code] The code skill's hand-back step reads say.md and question.md only when each exists and is not empty.
* [code_step resume routes a late review hand-back on its report](2026-10-26-code-step-resume-routes-a-late-review-hand-back-on.md) [script/code-step] After a wait-cap stop, `resume` routes a review-loop report that arrived late on that report, and the stale "never handed back" question is replaced.
* [gate env takes a run's values from its own plan alone](2026-10-26-gate-env-takes-a-run-s-values-from-its-own-plan.md) [script/plan-format, script/code-step] `repo_gate_env` returns only the run's own plan's `NAME=value` words when that plan is readable; values other plans agree on now fill in only for a run with no plan.
* [code_step commit list keeps a dirty-before file the phase edited](2026-10-26-code-step-commit-list-keeps-a-dirty-before-file.md) [script/code-step] The phase commit command now names a file that was dirty before the phase when the phase changed its content, and the hand-back flags it as mixing earlier edits; dirty files the phase left alone stay out.
* [code_step start --restart drops the old run before any check that can stop it](2026-10-26-code-step-start-restart-drops-the-old-run-before.md) [script/code-step] `start --restart` drops the old run before the gate and phase checks, so a start they stop leaves no open run for the next `start` to refuse.
* [code_step start lets the same session replace its stopped run and prints a restart form it accepts](2026-10-26-code-step-start-lets-the-same-session-replace-its.md) [script/code-step] A run that stopped on the coder's report no longer blocks the same session's next `start`, and the open-run refusal prints a `--restart` command the script accepts.
* [verify-prep and verify-log go on when the ledger stays busy](2026-10-26-verify-prep-and-verify-log-go-on-when-the-ledger.md) [script/verify-prep, script/verify-log, skill/verify-branch] A ledger that stays busy or behind no longer stops /verify-branch: the retries wait about a minute, the message names the wait and the ledger's own line, and a review that verify-log logged from this checkout for the same tree stands in for the ledger's answer.
* [Phase commit uses the plan's named commit line, never a none summary](2026-10-26-phase-commit-uses-the-plan-s-named-commit-line.md) [script/code-step] code_step's phase commit takes its subject from the phase's Commit `...` line in the plan when there is one; otherwise from the coder's Implemented summary, unless that summary starts with none, when it takes the phase title.
* [Criteria dry-run leaves closing-phase items to their skill, as the plan check does](2026-10-26-criteria-dry-run-leaves-closing-phase-items-to.md) [script/criteria-dry-run, skill/eng-spec] criteria_dry_run.py skips the Automated Verification items of closing phases (Refactor pass, Test audit, Verify pass, Recap), which their skill checks from the session's evidence and never runs, so it no longer reports them UNPARSED while the plan check passes them.
* [An ask outcome keeps the finding id of the ask row the loop logged](2026-10-26-an-ask-outcome-keeps-the-finding-id-of-the-ask-row.md) [script/review-loop-gate, script/handback, script/review-fix, script/code-step, agent/review-loop, shared/finding-log, skill/review, skill/fix] The review-loop stop hook pairs each ask row the loop logged with the finding id the log helper printed; review_fix.py and code_step.py fill each packet ask from those rows, or log the ask row themselves, so every ask outcome supersedes its ask row instead of landing under a new id.
* [A review-loop waiting on its own background agent is not a missing hand-back](2026-10-26-a-review-loop-waiting-on-its-own-background-agent.md) [script/review-loop-gate, script/handback, script/review-fix, skill/review, skill/fix] review_loop_gate.py records each review-loop stop with its count of open background agents; review_fix.py packet prints wait-for-loop, not stop-no-handback, while the loop waits, so /review and /fix no longer re-dispatch a second loop onto files the first loop's coder still edits.
* [A hand-back gate timeout is reported as a timeout, not a failing suite](2026-10-26-a-hand-back-gate-timeout-is-reported-as-a-timeout.md) [script/coder-gate, script/code-step] coder_gate.py records a command that hits its timeout apart from failures, lets the hand-back through stamped with the timeout and no test result, and code_step reports it as timed out; a new test covers the listed cargo commands on the --phase start path.
* [A review-loop hand-back with no reviewer run cannot turn the review gate clean](2026-10-26-a-review-loop-hand-back-with-no-reviewer-run.md) [agent/review-loop, script/handback, script/review-fix, script/script-utils, script/review-loop-gate] handback.py records the coder and reviewer dispatches each review-loop makes, and refuses a clean hand-back when no reviewer ran after the loop's last code change; +fast now only changes the reviewer model.
* [code_step keeps the ask-fix coder's behavior off the phase Implemented line](2026-10-26-code-step-keeps-the-ask-fix-coder-s-behavior-off.md) [script/code-step] An ask-fix coder BEHAVIOR line shows as its own Ask-fix line in say.md, not on the phase Implemented line or Behavior delta.
* [code_step carries a plan-impact round's other asks and pending findings](2026-10-26-code-step-carries-a-plan-impact-round-s-other-asks.md) [script/code-step] After a plan-impact review round, its other asks and pending findings go to the user and into the next review handoff.
* [review-scope stops when no base is found and the branch has commits of its own](2026-10-26-review-scope-stops-when-no-base-is-found-and-the.md) [skill/review] review-scope exits 3 with a clear message instead of printing a working-tree-only scope when no base ref exists and the branch holds commits no other ref has.
* [A search ban behind a leading cd now passes when the search finds nothing](2026-10-26-a-search-line-behind-a-leading-cd-is-judged-as-a.md) [script/code-step] A verification line whose rg or grep command starts with cd <dir> && now counts as a search ban like a bare one, so exit 1 with no match passes.
* [Test runner inside a command substitution is not judged no-test-matched](2026-10-26-test-runner-inside-a-command-substitution-is-not.md) [script/test-run-output, script/code-step] A test runner inside $(...) or backticks is not judged no-test-matched, because the outer command's output does not carry its report.
* [rg/grep presence check no longer read as a ban](2026-10-26-rg-grep-presence-check-no-longer-read-as-a-ban.md) [script/code-step, skill/eng-spec] An rg or grep Automated Verification line stays a ban unless its text says it checks presence; then exit 0 passes.
* [A cargo test name after option flags reads as a filtered run](2026-10-26-a-cargo-test-name-after-option-flags-reads-as-a.md) [script/criteria-dry-run, script/code-step] A cargo test command is filtered when a bare name follows its options, or any token follows --, so a name that matches no test reads RED in the eng-spec dry run and the code-phase verification.
* [code_step counts the hand-back cap from the agent's launch](2026-10-26-code-step-counts-the-hand-back-cap-from-the-agent.md) [script/code-step] The /code wait cap starts at the Agent call's launch, not at the printed dispatch, so a worker that holds a dispatch no longer gets a false has-not-handed-back stop.
* [The turn-end formatter skips plan files](2026-10-26-the-turn-end-formatter-skips-plan-files.md) [script/format-changed] format_changed.py no longer runs prettier or oxfmt on files under docs/plans/, so a plan's next Edit and its review shards still match the text on disk.
* [quality-check-cap skips help probes and allows a for-loop repeat](2026-10-26-quality-check-cap-skips-help-probes-and-allows-a.md) [script/quality-check-cap] The cap no longer counts a --help/-h/--version/-V call as a check run, and it allows a check repeated in one for loop over two or more values, so a flake check runs the same command N times without flag dodges.
* [asks-done records whether the user or the session ruled](2026-10-26-asks-done-records-whether-the-user-or-the-session.md) [script/review-fix, script/code-step, skill/review, script/log-review-finding] The asks-done verb of review_fix.py and code_step.py takes --by user|session, each ask outcome row carries ask_decided_by, and the ask prompts tell the session to rule itself when the repo's CLAUDE.md hands it ask decisions.
* [Code phase verification fails a filtered test run that matches no test](2026-10-26-code-phase-verification-fails-a-filtered-test-run.md) [script/code-step, script/criteria-dry-run] code_step_boundary.run_verification_commands marks a filtered test command that exits 0 and reports no passed test as failed, with the zero-test check criteria_dry_run.py already used, now shared from lib/test_run_output.py; mocha and bun summaries now count as passed tests.
* [code-step start and adr prep take long task text on Python before 3.14](2026-10-26-code-step-start-and-adr-prep-take-long-task-text.md) [script/code-step, script/adr-flow] code_step.py and adr_flow.py test argument words with os.path instead of pathlib, so a task text longer than a file name no longer crashes start with OSError File name too long on Python 3.13 and older.
* [Split command steps keeps a quoted operator in its step](2026-10-26-split-command-steps-keeps-a-quoted-operator-in-its.md) [script/quality-check-cap, script/rg-path-gate, script/shell-command] A quoted |, &&, || or ; stays inside its step, so a search pattern that names a check tool is no longer read as a run of it.
* [A filtered test run that matches no test reads RED in the eng-spec dry run](2026-10-26-a-filtered-test-run-that-matches-no-test-reads-red.md) [script/criteria-dry-run] The dry-run script marks a filtered test run RED unless the output reports at least one passed test.
* [Ruled /code asks reach later review and refactor passes](2026-10-26-ruled-code-asks-reach-later-review-and-refactor.md) [script/code-step, agent/review-loop, skill/refactor] asks-done and pre-set ask outcomes are saved in the code-step state directory, and later review hand-offs and the closing refactor prompt list them so a matching finding is dropped instead of raised again.
* [A /code phase stays open when its review loop did not converge](2026-10-26-a-code-phase-stays-open-when-its-review-loop-did.md) [script/code-step] code-step records how each review loop ended and, when it did not converge, leaves the phase open, commits nothing, records no reviewed-tree fingerprint and says what the run waits on.

## Week of 2026-10-19

### Added

* [Push and PR open list unchanged deferred bug findings](2026-10-24-push-and-pr-open-list-unchanged-deferred-bug.md) [script/deferred-push-check] A PreToolUse hook on Bash lists the branch's deferred bug and correctness findings whose code has not changed since review, each time Claude runs git push or gh pr create. It adds context and never denies.
* [One adr-flow call does the fixed steps of /adr](2026-10-20-one-adr-flow-call-does-the-fixed-steps-of-adr.md) [skill/adr, script/adr-flow] adr-flow.py prep resolves the task dir and prints the target path, PR url, sources and template. check validates the draft. finish checks it again and deletes the task dir only when every safety check passes.
* [One branch-base script picks the base branch for review-scope, test-reviewer and refactor](2026-10-20-one-branch-base-script-picks-the-base-branch-for.md) [script/branch-base, skill/review, agent/test-reviewer, skill/refactor] scripts/branch-base prints the default base ref of a branch and where it came from. review-scope, the test-reviewer branch scope and refactor-flow all call it, so the three no longer choose a base each their own way.
* [One verify-prep call does the fixed steps of verify-branch](2026-10-20-one-verify-prep-call-does-the-fixed-steps-of.md) [skill/verify-branch, script/code-step] verify-prep resolves the task dir, reads the criteria, measures the diff, checks for a branch-wide review since the last change and prints the exact dispatches; verify-log writes the run and gap rows. The Verify pass in /code only invokes /verify-branch, which owns the branch-wide review.
* [Toolkit script rules: real inputs, one grammar, loud failures](2026-10-20-toolkit-script-rules-real-inputs-one-grammar-loud.md) [rule/toolkit-scripts] One rules file for every toolkit script and draft, loaded by the dotfiles and agent-evals project rules: read the real inputs first, one grammar per format with loud failures, check callers and real hook events, handle changes during a run, and test the draft and the installed copy.
* [Deny unbounded waits in subagent Bash calls](2026-10-19-deny-unbounded-waits-in-subagent-bash-calls.md) [script/wait-loop-gate] A new PreToolUse Bash hook denies a subagent's wait that has no time limit: an until or while loop with sleep, a long for loop with sleep, follow-mode log reads, and a sleep over 30 s. The deny reason gives the counted-loop form. At work, these waits ran to the 10-minute Bash ceiling and took about 4.3 hours of agent time over 3 days.

### Changed

* [Global rule: tell the user about a toolkit bug or inefficiency, then queue it in agent-evals](2026-10-25-global-rule-tell-the-user-about-a-toolkit-bug-or.md) [rule/global-claude-md] The global CLAUDE.md gains a section: a session that notices a toolkit bug or inefficiency tells the user first, then adds an agent-evals queue item, with no work content on the work machine.
* [Global rule: cap test workers and run one heavy job at a time](2026-10-25-global-rule-cap-test-workers-and-run-one-heavy-job.md) [rule/global-claude-md] The global CLAUDE.md gains a Machine Load section: cap test-runner workers at 2 in the repo config, run one heavy job at a time, check free memory first, and read the kernel log after a crash.
* [Fail the toolkit test run on new duplicate code](2026-10-25-fail-the-toolkit-test-run-on-new-duplicate-code.md) [script/duplicate-code, script/parallel-tests] tests/run.sh now runs tests/duplicate_code.py, which fails when a toolkit script defines a top-level function name another script already defines, or when jscpd finds a new token clone; today's repeats sit in a baseline that may only shrink.
* [Remove every duplicate in the toolkit scripts; fail on any repeat](2026-10-25-remove-every-duplicate-in-the-toolkit-scripts-fail.md) [script/script-utils, script/hook-input, script/code-step, script/review-fix, script/verify-common, script/verify-prep, script/verify-log, script/refactor-flow, script/adr-flow, script/deferred-push-check, script/git-discipline-gate, script/stale-citation-gate, script/shell-write-gate, script/comment-bloat-gate, script/dead-prose-gate, script/log-agent-usage, script/log-skill-use, script/telemetry-enabled, script/duplicate-code] The duplicate check dropped its baseline and now fails on any repeated function name or jscpd clone; 29 repeated names and 14 clones moved into lib/script_utils.py and lib/hook_input.py or got names of their own.
* [Coder hand-back gate lists stale comment and doc lines](2026-10-25-coder-hand-back-gate-lists-stale-comment-and-doc.md) [agent/coder, skill/code, agent/code-reviewer] The coder's hand-back gate on every plan phase runs stale_prose.py, which lists the comment and doc lines that name a symbol the diff renamed, removed or changed, so the coder fixes stale prose before review. **cuts stale doc lines left of 15 by 72% (12.1 → 3.4)**
* [Read git output through one shared lib function](2026-10-25-read-git-output-through-one-shared-lib-function.md) [script/script-utils, script/code-step, script/coder-gate, script/coder-packet, script/review-fix, script/review-commit-gate, script/quality-check-cap] Six toolkit scripts and one lib helper each ran git through their own git_output copy; they now all call script_utils.git_output, which drops stderr, turns path quoting off, keeps non-UTF-8 names and takes an optional timeout.
* [Own-branch /peer-review catches log as peer-review escapes; each run logs own-branch or teammate](2026-10-25-own-branch-peer-review-catches-log-as-peer-review.md) [skill/escape, skill/peer-review] /escape gains a peer-review stage; /peer-review logs one row per run saying whether the PR is the user's own, and on an own-branch run hands each kept defect to /escape.
* [Hand the user one chained command line, not a series](2026-10-25-hand-the-user-one-chained-command-line-not-a.md) [rule/global-claude-md] The global CLAUDE.md now tells the session to give the user one `!` line that chains every command with &&, in place of a series of lines.
* [Never add a session attribution line to a commit or PR](2026-10-25-never-add-a-session-attribution-line-to-a-commit.md) [rule/global-claude-md] The global CLAUDE.md now forbids a Claude-Session line, a session link or any attribution line in a commit message or PR body, over any harness reminder.
* [Coder guard refuses whole-suite make and docker checks](2026-10-24-coder-guard-refuses-whole-suite-make-and-docker.md) [script/coder-gate] The coder bash guard reads a make target's Makefile text and the command inside a docker exec or run call, and refuses the call when it runs a whole test suite, lint or build.
* [Toolkit edits need a bench proof sized by task class](2026-10-24-toolkit-edits-need-a-bench-proof-sized-by-task.md) [method/bench, method/protocol] From 2026-10-25 a change file's kind is fix, user-rule, structured or open; structured and open must cite findings with 8 or 32 runs per arm, and a dotfiles pre-commit hook refuses a toolkit commit with no change file.
* [The metrics switch reads only the environment variable](2026-10-24-the-metrics-switch-reads-only-the-environment.md) [script/telemetry-enabled] The metrics writers log only when CLAUDE_TOOLKIT_TELEMETRY=1. The file ~/.claude/toolkit-telemetry no longer turns logging on, and the ~/dev/evals/ folder check is gone because nothing else turns it on.
* [Review-loop runs its checks in the foreground](2026-10-24-review-loop-runs-its-checks-in-the-foreground.md) [agent/review-loop] The wait-loop hook now refuses every background job review-loop starts: run_in_background, a lone &, nohup, setsid and disown. The refusal tells it to run the same command in the foreground with a Bash timeout up to 600000 ms.
* [Escape loggers file false or stale prose as docs](2026-10-24-escape-loggers-file-false-or-stale-prose-as-docs.md) [skill/escape, skill/cc, skill/commit, skill/pr-comments] The four skills that log escapes by hand name the `docs` class, and the two that log review comments say a false or stale comment, doc or description is `docs`, never `smell` or `other`. The logger already accepted `docs`; the skills never offered it.
* [The code reviewer checks every prose claim against the code](2026-10-24-the-code-reviewer-checks-every-prose-claim-against.md) [agent/code-reviewer] The code reviewer gains a prose-claims lens. Every comment, docstring, doc, ADR and run-time description that the diff adds, or that names something the diff changes, must hold for the code after the diff. A false or stale claim is a fix, never a smell or a nit.
* [Toolkit scripts sorted into code, review, gates, telemetry, lib and tools folders](2026-10-24-toolkit-scripts-sorted-into-code-review-gates.md) [script/code-step] The 52 flat scripts in ~/.claude/scripts moved into six folders by concern. Hook commands, imports and logic are unchanged; only paths changed.
* [Build the design now covers module splits and folder layout](2026-10-24-build-the-design-now-covers-module-splits-and.md) [rule/global-claude-md] The global rule against deferred design now names module splits and folder layout, and says small size is no reason to wait.
* [code-step is split into four modules and reads every hand-back from one event log](2026-10-24-split-code-step-into-four-modules-hand-backs-read.md) [script/code-step] code-step reads every hand-back from one record with one match rule, its hooks no longer write the state file, four unused edge cases are gone, and no function in it is over complexity 10.
* [Toolkit Python follows PEP 8 names and a full ruff rule set](2026-10-24-toolkit-python-follows-pep-8-names-and-a-full-ruff.md) [script/code-step, script/coder-gate, script/review-fix] The 28 kebab-case toolkit scripts get snake_case file names, camelCase identifiers become snake_case, and ruff lints E,W,F,I,N,B,UP,SIM,C4,RUF at 120 columns on every suite run.
* [The user never waits on tests or lint](2026-10-24-the-user-never-waits-on-tests-or-lint.md) [agent/review-loop] The global quality-checks block now says the agent runs the full suite and lint on the files an install command writes before it hands that command over, and the command only writes files.
* [The worktree rule names tuios beside herdr](2026-10-24-the-worktree-rule-names-tuios-beside-herdr.md) [skill/herdr] The worktree line in orchestration.md now sends a session inside tuios to `herdr-worktree --fork`, the same as inside herdr. tuios sets `HERDR_ENV` too.
* [Review asks carry the finding id the logger printed](2026-10-24-review-asks-carry-the-finding-id-the-logger.md) [agent/review-loop, skill/review, skill/fix] Each ask in the review-loop packet carries the `finding_id` that log-review-finding printed, the ask outcome supersedes the ask row by that id, and `desc=` is no longer stored.
* [The /code skill passes a closing skill only with no open finding](2026-10-24-the-code-skill-passes-a-closing-skill-only-with-no.md) [skill/code] The /code skill's invoke-skill step now says which verdict to send: `skill-done pass` only when the closing skill reports no open finding, else `skill-done fail`. Before, it named both and gave no rule.
* [One resume verb for every /code run that stopped](2026-10-24-one-resume-verb-for-every-code-run-that-stopped.md) [script/code-step, skill/code] `code-step.py resume` replaces `continue`, `after-coder`, `after-review` and `after-plan-edit` as the one way to go on with a stopped /code run. `start` refuses over an open run and names `resume` or `start --restart`. Six stop routes that no run reached are cut, and the /code skill runs `resume` for empty task text.
* [The test suite lints the toolkit Python](2026-10-23-the-test-suite-lints-the-toolkit-python.md) [script/calibration-guard, script/claudemd-linecount, script/comment-bloat-gate] `tests/run.sh` runs ruff over the toolkit scripts and their tests before the test run. An unused import, an unused variable or an undefined name fails the suite. A report of functions over complexity 10 prints but does not fail. Five files lose an unused import.
* [Script rules: cap edge-case code and script size](2026-10-23-script-rules-cap-edge-case-code-and-script-size.md) [rule/toolkit-script-rules] The toolkit script rules no longer ask for a route and a test for every change that can happen during a run. Only reported changes get a route, and the rest go to one fallback stop. A new Size section asks for a sighting before new code, reuse of shared helpers, a split before features in a script over 1000 lines, and a stop when a diff is more than twice its design estimate.
* [A dirty commit is denied with a /review reason instead of a prompt](2026-10-23-a-dirty-commit-is-denied-with-a-review-reason.md) [script/review-commit-gate] `review-commit-gate` denies a `git commit` while coder work from the session has no converged review. The reason tells the session to run /review and commit after it converges. A docs-only commit chain that ends in `git rev-parse` now passes. An internal error in the gate still asks.
* [code-step runs scoped Rust tests and refuses checks that never end](2026-10-23-code-step-runs-scoped-rust-tests-and-refuses.md) [script/code-step, script/plan-format, shared/plan-format] For a Rust phase, the hand-back check runs only the test targets that hold the changed files (the lib, a bin or one test file), not every target in the workspace. A verification item that never ends (`tail -f`, `watch`, `sleep`, an editor, `claude`) or a bare word that is not a program is refused when the plan is written. A plan can mark an item CI-verified or human-only, and code-step does not run it.
* [Test writers and reviewers look across the whole suite for a test that already catches the bug](2026-10-23-test-writers-and-reviewers-look-across-the-whole.md) [skill/coder-core, agent/test-reviewer, agent/test-intent-reviewer, skill/plan-format] The coder, both test reviewers and the plan format treat any test in the suite, at any layer, as a sibling. A rule's case table is tested at one layer, with one wiring test per other entry point.
* [Sign-offs record who and when, not the user's words](2026-10-23-sign-offs-record-who-and-when-not-the-user-s-words.md) [rule/global-claude-md, agent/plan-verifier, skill/verify-branch, skill/plan-format] A sign-off that overrides a ticket criterion or moves a phase now records who signed off and when. It no longer quotes the user.
* [The plan format and verify-branch skill now describe the gate, moved-phase and verdict-row rules](2026-10-23-plan-format-and-verify-branch-text-match-the-new.md) [skill/plan-format, skill/verify-branch] The shared plan format says that /code stops at an open gated phase and documents the `[-]` moved-phase mark. The verify-branch skill says that verify-log exits 2 when a criterion id has no row.
* [A no-op asks coder ticks the phase when it names where each ask is done](2026-10-22-a-no-op-asks-coder-ticks-the-phase-when-it-names.md) [script/code-step] When the asks coder changes nothing, code-step now runs the phase's verification commands and ticks, if the report has one `ALREADY-DONE: <n> — <file:line>` line for every accepted ask and raises no blocker. Every other no-change report still stops.
* [verify-log writes nothing when a criterion id has no verdict row](2026-10-22-verify-log-writes-nothing-when-a-criterion-id-has.md) [script/verify-log] verify-log now exits 2, names the criterion ids with no verdict row and writes no rows. Before, it logged each absent id as a `missing` gap.
* [A plan phase can be marked moved to another ticket](2026-10-22-a-plan-phase-can-be-marked-moved-to-another-ticket.md) [script/plan-format, script/code-step, script/verify-common, script/verify-log, script/script-utils] The plan grammar accepts `- [-] Phase <id>: … moved to <KEY>` with a Plan Deviations line that records the move. code-step never runs a moved phase, and verify-branch lists it as moved, not as done or missing.
* [Let a dirty session commit docs-only changes without asking](2026-10-22-let-a-dirty-session-commit-docs-only-changes.md) [script/review-commit-gate, script/shell-command] review-commit-gate.py no longer asks the user when a dirty session commits only docs/**.md files, and it now asks for git commit forms it used to miss.
* [code-step logs each dispatch to an event log and denies a coder launch without its packet](2026-10-21-code-step-logs-each-dispatch-to-an-event-log-and.md) [script/code-step, script/script-utils] code-step writes each dispatch, launch, resume and hand-back to one event log per run, saves each dispatch prompt to a file that ends in a marker line, and a new PreToolUse hook denies a launch whose prompt does not hold the whole saved prompt.
* [Script tests run with one fixed git config so CI and local agree](2026-10-21-script-tests-run-with-one-fixed-git-config-so-ci.md) [script/parallel-tests] The script test runner gives every test process one fixed global git config, no system config, empty ignore and attributes files, and no git config from the environment. The CI workflow loses its own git setup step.
* [Toolkit telemetry stays off in eval run trees unless a run turns it on](2026-10-21-toolkit-telemetry-stays-off-in-eval-run-trees.md) [script/telemetry-enabled] The telemetry switch is off for a session whose project folder is inside ~/dev/evals/, unless CLAUDE_TOOLKIT_TELEMETRY=1. CLAUDE_TOOLKIT_TELEMETRY=0 turns it off everywhere, even when the switch file exists. Eval runs no longer write test rows into the live logs.
* [code-step runs env-prefixed checks, clippy for Rust phases, and commits a plan edited before the phase](2026-10-21-code-step-runs-env-prefixed-checks-clippy-for-rust.md) [script/code-step, script/plan-format, script/coder-packet, script/script-utils] code-step reads a verification command with leading NAME=value assignments and runs it with them set. A phase that touches Rust code gets a clippy gate. The phase commit includes the plan when the phase ticked it, even if the plan had edits before the phase. coder-packet no longer reads Phase 6.1 as Phase 6. One plan parser and one stage-guard table replace the duplicates.
* [The review-loop stop gate writes the reviewer run rows](2026-10-21-the-review-loop-stop-gate-writes-the-reviewer-run.md) [script/review-loop-gate, skill/review, agent/review-loop] The review-loop stop gate writes one kind=run row for each reviewer the loop dispatched, with the finding count read from the reviewer's report. Before, the loop agent wrote these rows from its own prose, and it skipped or mixed them up.
* [A plan-impact ruling names who made it, and only the user's ruling changes the criteria](2026-10-21-a-plan-impact-ruling-names-who-made-it-and-only.md) [script/code-step, script/review-fix, skill/code, skill/review, skill/fix] decide adopt|keep needs --by user|session. Only --by user signs with the git user name and lets the plan-edit coder rewrite the acceptance criteria. A session or pre-set ruling edits the plan only, and code-step.py restores the criteria if the coder changes them.
* [The /code routing script runs each dispatch in the background and keeps the run in one session](2026-10-20-the-code-routing-script-runs-each-dispatch-in-the.md) [script/code-step, skill/code] code-step.py prints a background dispatch and the next verb waits for the agent's report. Hooks store the hand-backs, keep the fork alive while a dispatch is open and print say.md as the closing text. The run pins to one session.
* [One refactor-flow call does the fixed steps of each /refactor mode](2026-10-20-one-refactor-flow-call-does-the-fixed-steps-of.md) [skill/refactor, script/refactor-flow] refactor-flow.py has one prep verb per mode, a log verb that writes the escape and finding rows once, and a handoff verb that renders the review hand-off. Each verb ends with a NEXT or STOP line.
* [The metrics writers run only while the telemetry switch is on](2026-10-20-the-metrics-writers-run-only-while-the-telemetry.md) [script/telemetry-switch] Every metrics writer checks one helper first. The switch is on when CLAUDE_TOOLKIT_TELEMETRY=1 is set or the file ~/.claude/toolkit-telemetry exists. Off, each writer skips its write and exits 0.
* [Review a whole branch with review base=ref](2026-10-20-review-a-whole-branch-with-review-base-ref.md) [agent/review-loop, skill/review] `/review base=<ref>` passes a `base: <ref>` input to the review loop, which hands it to review-scope, so one review covers every change since that ref, commits included.
* [The review-loop agent file pins the sonnet model](2026-10-20-the-review-loop-agent-file-pins-the-sonnet-model.md) [agent/review-loop] `agents/review-loop.md` frontmatter now holds `model: sonnet`, so a dispatch that names no model runs the loop on Sonnet and does not take the model of the session that dispatched it.
* [Run the review-loop execution gate past the repeat-check cap](2026-10-20-run-the-review-loop-execution-gate-past-the-repeat.md) [agent/review-loop] The review loop's one full quality-check run now carries a trailing `#skip-quality-cap`, so the cap on repeated checks cannot deny the gate that decides convergence. (reverted by 2026-10-21-the-review-loop-gate-run-drops-the-repeat-check)
* [Prescribe toolkit logging calls as plain commands by path](2026-10-20-prescribe-toolkit-logging-calls-as-plain-commands.md) [agent/review-loop, skill/review, skill/fix, skill/cc, skill/escape, skill/refactor, skill/commit, skill/pr-comments, skill/verify-branch, skill/test-audit, skill/eng-spec] The review-scope, log-review-finding and log-escape calls in the review loop and eight skills are now one plain command by the script path, with no `bash "$HOME/..."`, variable, array or `$(...)`, because a worktree-isolated session refuses those forms.
* [One review-fix call builds the packet for review and fix](2026-10-20-one-review-fix-call-builds-the-packet-for-review.md) [skill/review, skill/fix, script/review-fix, script/handback, script/review-commit-gate] A hook saves the review loop's hand-back and the commit gate refuses a false clean mark. One review-fix.py call parses it, routes on its status, renders the user text, opens the asks in the editor and logs the rows, so /review and /fix leave the model only the asks and the closing line.
* [One plan grammar with a check at write time, and closing phases after coding phases](2026-10-20-one-plan-grammar-with-a-check-at-write-time-and.md) [script/code-step, skill/eng-spec] code-step reads every plan through one parse function that stops on any line it cannot read, checks a plan when it is written, and runs the closing phases only after every coding phase, so a phase added during a run cannot run after the Verify pass.
* [A small follow-up re-review does not re-send the structure and test reviewers](2026-10-20-a-small-follow-up-re-review-does-not-re-send-the.md) [agent/review-loop, script/code-step] When /code reviews again after the coder that applies accepted asks, or after a plan ruling, and that coder's own change is small, the review carries `structure-pass: skip` and the review loop sends only the code reviewer.
* [One call runs the fixed steps of /stage](2026-10-20-one-call-runs-the-fixed-steps-of-stage.md) [skill/stage] `stage.mjs --run` classifies once, stages the SAFE tier, writes the metrics row and prints the finished report and jump list. The model keeps only the per-entry notes, the nvim-jump call and tier disagreements.
* [Re-review after the asks coder covers only its own diff](2026-10-20-re-review-after-the-asks-coder-covers-only-its-own.md) [script/code-step] After the user rules on review asks and a coder applies them, the next review reads only the files that coder changed. A docs-only asks diff ends the phase with no review.
* [Rename the branch-end completeness skill to verify-branch](2026-10-20-rename-the-branch-end-completeness-skill-to-verify.md) [skill/verify, skill/verify-branch, script/code-step, agent/review-loop, agent/plan-verifier, skill/branch-recap, skill/escape] Claude Code 2.1.304 ships its own skill named verify, and adds the line 'Always run /verify right before the commit command' to the Bash tool instructions when any skill has that name. With the user's skill also named verify, the line sent agents to the branch-end completeness check before each commit. The user's skill is now verify-branch, so the name verify means only Claude Code's skill.
* [Run the 19 shell hooks as Python scripts](2026-10-20-run-the-19-shell-hooks-as-python-scripts.md) [script/shell-write-gate, script/quality-check-cap, script/git-discipline-gate, script/review-commit-gate, script/comment-bloat-gate, script/stale-citation-gate, script/dead-prose-gate, script/claudemd-linecount, script/calibration-refs-guard, script/spec-budget-gate, script/test-edit-telemetry, script/agent-model-guard, script/agent-foreground, script/log-agent-usage, script/log-skill-use, script/format-changed, script/emit-orchestration, script/calibration-guard, script/warn-skip-hooks, script/batch-reads-nudge, script/claude-doctor, skill/review] 19 hooks written in bash now run as Python scripts with the same decisions and output. batch-reads-nudge points straight at its Python file. At work, each bash hook takes 110–470 ms per call because bash and every program it starts are slow to launch there. Python starts in 13 ms. The predicted cut is about 0.5 s of hook time per Bash call at work.
* [Ticket acceptance criteria are the contract, and /verify checks them with or without a plan](2026-10-19-ticket-acceptance-criteria-are-the-contract-and.md) [rule/global-claude-md, agent/plan-verifier, skill/verify] Only the user's explicit sign-off overrides a ticket acceptance criterion. The plan verifier checks every ticket criterion from the ticket's own words, marks one that the plan dropped without sign-off as missing, and marks one about what a user sees as needs-manual unless a captured run shows it. /verify runs ticket-only when no plan exists.
* [/code passes the user's ruling on a plan disagreement to the review, so the review stops asking it again](2026-10-19-code-passes-the-user-s-ruling-on-a-plan.md) [script/code-step, agent/review-loop, shared/handoff-block] When the code and the plan disagree, /code records the user's answer, in their words, as a ruling. The review after it gets the ruling as a RESOLVED block and reviews the code against it. Before, the review raised the same disagreement again after the user answered, and a work run looped.
* [/code asks the user through say.md, and an adopted plan change gets a plan-edit coder before the review](2026-10-19-code-asks-the-user-through-say-md-and-an-adopted.md) [skill/code, script/code-step] /code writes every question for the user into say.md. When the user adopts a plan change, a coder rewrites the contradicted plan steps before the review, so one disagreement gets one question and one review.
* [The review loop sends every `fix` finding of a full review to a coder at any round](2026-10-19-the-review-loop-sends-every-fix-finding-of-a-full.md) [agent/review-loop, skill/fix, agent/code-reviewer] The review loop sends every `fix` finding of a full review to a coder at any round, and the first fix-diff pass now routes like a full review: every `fix` finding it files gets a coder, blocker or not.
* [`/code` runs as a forked Sonnet subagent (`context: fork`, `model: sonnet`)](2026-10-19-code-runs-as-a-forked-sonnet-subagent-context-fork.md) [skill/code, script/code-step] `/code` runs as a forked Sonnet subagent (`context: fork`, `model: sonnet`).
* [The main session reads an agent's report before stopping an agent that still shows background work](2026-10-19-orchestration-md-delegation-when-an-agent-s.md) [rule/orchestration] When an agent's completion notice says it still runs background work, the main session reads the report, and stops the agent with TaskStop only when the job is done and no work is awaited.
* [`/code` step 3: the gate's lint command takes `{files:<suffixes>}` in place of the phase's path list](2026-10-19-code-step-3-the-gate-s-lint-command-takes-files.md) [skill/code, script/coder-gate] `/code` step 3: the gate's lint command takes `{files:<suffixes>}` in place of the phase's path list.
* [`review-loop` re-reviews with a fresh reviewer and fixes with a fresh coder each round](2026-10-19-review-loop-a-re-review-dispatches-a-fresh.md) [agent/review-loop, shared/handoff-block] A re-review in `review-loop` dispatches a fresh reviewer of the same type with the Agent tool and passes it the handoff block, and each fix round dispatches a fresh coder. The loop no longer hands back before the re-review result and the full check.
* [A coder never runs a whole test suite, a whole-package lint or a build](2026-10-19-a-coder-never-runs-a-whole-test-suite-a-whole.md) [skill/coder-core, agent/review-loop, script/coder-gate] A coder never runs a whole test suite, a whole-package lint or a build.
* [`/code` gives the coder a reading list and moves the checks to a hook at hand-back](2026-10-19-code-gives-the-coder-a-reading-list-and-moves-the.md) [skill/code, script/coder-gate, agent/review-loop, script/coder-packet, skill/coder-core] `/code` gives the coder a reading list and moves the checks to a hook at hand-back.

### Removed

* [The review loop drops the fix-diff verification pass](2026-10-25-the-review-loop-drops-the-fix-diff-verification.md) [agent/review-loop, script/review-loop-gate, script/log-review-finding, shared/finding-log] No reviewer reads a fix diff that no full review follows, the execution gate is its only read, the loop gate no longer blocks on an unread fix diff, and a review-loop fix finding defers only as an open class member.
* [Eng-spec finalization runs one less command and no longer shows false lint findings](2026-10-21-retire-the-spec-criteria-lint.md) [script/spec-criteria-lint, skill/eng-spec, shared/escape-ratchet] The eng-spec finalization step no longer runs spec-criteria-lint.sh, so the user no longer resolves false lint findings before Phase 7. The script is deleted: its one check, verification paths that no phase creates, was wrong on every report it made.
* [Agent dispatches are no longer forced to run in the foreground](2026-10-21-remove-the-hook-that-forced-agents-to-run-in-the.md) [script/agent-foreground] Agent dispatches keep the background setting they ask for: the PreToolUse hook that set run_in_background to false on every dispatch is deleted. It did not hold, and the reason for it no longer exists: a subagent now gets the finish notice of its own background agents.
* [Only the Python version of 20 ported hooks is left, and the port workspace is cleaned up](2026-10-21-retire-the-bash-copies-of-ported-hooks-and-the.md) [script/agent-foreground, script/agent-model-guard, script/batch-reads-nudge, script/calibration-guard, script/calibration-refs-guard, script/claudemd-linecount, script/comment-bloat-gate, script/dead-prose-gate, script/emit-orchestration, script/format-changed, script/git-discipline-gate, script/log-agent-usage, script/log-skill-use, script/quality-check-cap, script/review-commit-gate, script/shell-write-gate, script/spec-budget-gate, script/stale-citation-gate, script/test-edit-telemetry, script/warn-skip-hooks, script/claude-doctor, script/review-gate-mark] The installer deletes the bash copy of 20 hooks whose Python port settings.json runs, then deletes the port workspace ~/dev/evals/hookport/, so a reader no longer finds a file that runs nowhere. Script prose stops naming the old .sh files.

### Fixed

* [Review commit gate credits merges, user-ordered commits, reviewed trees and the repo a commit runs in](2026-10-25-review-commit-gate-credits-merges-user-ordered.md) [script/review-commit-gate] A dirty session now commits a merge, a commit the user ordered with a [no-review] prompt, a tree a converged review covered, and judges git -C commits by the target repo.
* [A grep or rg ban holds when the search finds nothing](2026-10-25-a-grep-or-rg-ban-holds-when-the-search-finds.md) [script/code-step] A plan ban written as a bare rg or grep command is now judged by match, like a git grep ban, so it holds when the search finds nothing. Before, the command exited 1 on no match, which code-step read as a failed command and stopped the run.
* [Scope boxes diff recorded commits, not a branch name](2026-10-25-scope-boxes-diff-recorded-commits-not-a-branch.md) [script/code-step, skill/eng-spec] plan check now fails a plan box that diffs main...HEAD, and the closing-phase text names the form that survives merge and fails when empty. Before, such a box read nothing once the branch merged, so a box ticked after merge passed with nothing checked.
* [eng-spec plan check fails an AC id that names a different criterion](2026-10-25-eng-spec-plan-check-fails-an-ac-id-that-names-a.md) [script/code-step, skill/eng-spec] plan check now fails a bare AC reference in spec.md that is not that criterion's id. Before, the spec was written before the criteria file, so its bare AC numbers carried the ticket's numbering while the criteria file numbered its own.
* [Quality-check cap lets a scoped cargo test run](2026-10-25-quality-check-cap-lets-a-scoped-cargo-test-run.md) [script/quality-check-cap] The quality-check cap no longer denies a repeat of a cargo test scoped to a named lib, doc, test target, bin or filter; the unscoped run stays capped.
* [Review ask outcomes with no finding id are logged under a new id](2026-10-25-review-ask-outcomes-with-no-finding-id-are-logged.md) [script/review-fix, script/code-step, script/handback, agent/review-loop] When a review-loop hands back an ask with no valid finding_id, review_fix.py asks-done and code-step now log the user's answer under a new id instead of dropping it.
* [Deny bare rg with no path before it hangs on stdin](2026-10-25-deny-bare-rg-with-no-path-before-it-hangs-on-stdin.md) [script/rg-path-gate] A Bash call of rg with no path, alone or first in a pipeline, is denied with the same command plus a dot, so the search runs in a second instead of hanging until the timeout.
* [bash-safety-gate pipe-to-shell rule reads real pipes only](2026-10-25-bash-safety-gate-pipe-to-shell-rule-reads-real.md) [script/bash-safety-gate, script/pipe-shell-check, script/shell-command] The pipe-to-shell rule no longer denies a pipe character inside a quoted argument, such as the regex (py|sh).
* [Give spec-research and spec-criteria the Edit tool](2026-10-25-give-spec-research-and-spec-criteria-the-edit-tool.md) [agent/spec-research, agent/spec-criteria] Agents that write a file they may later correct now have Edit, so a blocked sed -i no longer pushes them to an inline Python rewrite.
* [The main-branch guard in the bash safety hook reads only each push command's own arguments](2026-10-25-the-main-branch-guard-in-the-bash-safety-hook.md) [script/bash-safety-gate, script/git-push-main-check] The main-branch guard no longer denies a chained command that holds push and a main or master word in different commands.
* [Wrapped shell block names the direct form](2026-10-25-wrapped-shell-block-names-the-direct-form.md) [script/bash-safety-gate] The deny text for a wrapped shell command now tells the agent to run the inner command directly as its own Bash call.
* [Credential and review-commit blocks tell the agent to carry on](2026-10-25-credential-and-review-commit-blocks-tell-the-agent.md) [script/review-commit-gate, script/block-credential-read, script/bash-safety-gate] The review commit gate and the credential-read blocks now tell the agent to continue the task, so a main-session turn no longer ends on the block.
* [The review logger saves a dirty reviewed tree as a commit](2026-10-25-the-review-logger-saves-a-dirty-reviewed-tree-as-a.md) [script/log-review-finding] A review row logged on a dirty tree now carries snapshot, a commit on HEAD of the tree the gate saw, kept under refs/review-snapshots/<id>, so the frozen review set can use the dirty rows it used to drop.
* [code-step start takes a phase named after the plan, and the refactor skill shows a log input that parses](2026-10-25-code-step-start-takes-a-phase-named-after-the-plan.md) [script/code-step, skill/refactor] `code_step.py start <plan> Phase <id>` and `start <plan> <id>` start that phase where they used to stop on 'text after the plan', and the /refactor skill shows a JSON log input that `refactor_flow.py log` accepts, so two first calls that callers got wrong daily now pass.
* [The /code question for the user outlives the Stop hook, and resume takes the user's answer](2026-10-25-the-code-question-for-the-user-outlives-the-stop.md) [script/code-step, skill/code] code_step.py writes every ask-user question to question.md, which the Stop say-hook never empties, and `resume <answer>` at a stopped coder puts the answer in that question instead of refusing it, so a /code run that stops for the user no longer hands back an empty question.
* [Review-flow scripts: every function under complexity 10, dead CLI surface cut](2026-10-25-review-flow-scripts-every-function-under.md) [script/review-fix, script/handback, script/review-loop-gate, script/review-commit-gate, script/code-step] review_fix, handback, review_loop_gate and review_commit_gate hold no function over C901 10 and tests/run.sh fails on one; the hand-back latest verb, kind inference, the --check dry run, the Task tool name and the unused packet keys are gone.
* [Refactor branch sweep reads the diff through the shared parser](2026-10-25-refactor-branch-sweep-reads-the-diff-through-the.md) [skill/refactor] refactor_flow's sweep for markers and commented-out code now reads the branch diff with lib/source_text.parse_unified_diff, not its own line walker, so a line that holds a form feed or a lone carriage return is swept whole.
* [The dotfiles suite fails when ruff is missing](2026-10-25-the-dotfiles-suite-fails-when-ruff-is-missing.md) [script/run-sh] tests/run.sh stops with exit 1 and an install line when ruff is not on PATH, where it used to print 'lint skipped' and pass, so a lint or complexity defect can no longer ship through a suite run on a machine without ruff.
* [A code-step test run no longer opens files in the user's Neovim](2026-10-25-code-step-tests-jump-through-a-fake-nvim-jump.md) [script/code-step] code_step.py present_asks reads the nvim-jump command from CODE_STEP_NVIM_JUMP, like review_fix.py's REVIEW_FIX_NVIM_JUMP, and the code-step tests set it to a fake, so a test run no longer opens its temp files in the user's Neovim.
* [Code-step wait tests no longer fail when the suite runs under load](2026-10-25-code-step-wait-tests-set-their-own-cap-so-suite.md) [script/code-step] The code-step hand-back cap now reads an optional CODE_STEP_WAIT_MULTIPLE, which defaults to the same three waits; the tests that expect a wait set it to 60, so a slow setup under suite load no longer turns their wait into a cap stop.
* [Toolkit script fixes: drop the dead hand-back gate, kill a timed-out coder check's process group, one plan-deviation format](2026-10-25-toolkit-script-fixes-drop-the-dead-hand-back-gate.md) [script/coder-gate, script/script-utils, script/review-loop-gate, script/plan-format, script/code-step, script/review-fix] A coder-gate check that times out now kills its whole process group and reports what it printed; the unregistered review-loop hand-back gate is gone; code_step and review_fix write plan-impact rulings in one format.
* [Stale-prose and refactor scripts share the lib git runner and C-path decoder](2026-10-25-stale-prose-and-refactor-scripts-share-the-lib-git.md) [script/script-utils, script/source-text, script/stale-prose, script/refactor-flow] stale_prose now runs git through script_utils.run_or_raise and refactor_flow decodes quoted paths through source_text. The stale-prose merge had brought back a git_output copy and a second unquote_c_path, which the duplicate check failed on.
* [/code review asks survive a new session and carry one proposed change](2026-10-25-code-review-asks-survive-a-new-session-and-carry.md) [script/code-step, script/handback, script/review-fix, agent/review-loop, agent/code-reviewer, agent/smell-reviewer, agent/test-reviewer, shared/reviewer-calibration, skill/review, skill/fix] A /code run now pins to the session that opens each dispatch, so open review asks and a review-again hand-back survive a new session; a resume at a closing phase re-invokes its skill; and every structured review ask carries one proposed change, so an accepted answer gives the asks coder an edit to make.
* [Git-only Bash hooks spawn only when the command names git or gh](2026-10-25-git-only-bash-hooks-spawn-only-when-the-command.md) [script/git-discipline-gate, script/review-commit-gate, script/deferred-push-check] The git discipline gate, the review commit gate and the deferred push check now carry `if` filters on their PreToolUse Bash entries, so a Bash call that never mentions git or gh no longer spawns three Python processes. The filters start with a wildcard, because an anchored `Bash(git *)` let wrapped forms such as `env git commit` skip the gate.
* [Dotfiles tests and scripts find toolkit code in their own checkout](2026-10-25-dotfiles-tests-and-scripts-find-toolkit-code-in.md) [script/code-step, script/review-fix, script/review-loop-gate, script/verify-common, script/adr-flow, script/refactor-flow, script/review-scope, skill/stage] The test suite and ten scripts now find toolkit code from their own file location, so a script change can be edited and fully tested in a dotfiles worktree before the user merges it. Before, they went through ~/.claude, so a suite run in a worktree tested the live scripts instead of the edited ones.
* [A misworded Automated Verification heading stops the code step](2026-10-24-a-misworded-automated-verification-heading-stops.md) [script/plan-format, script/code-step] The code step now stops, with the file line, at a level 4 heading that holds automated and verif but is not the exact `#### Automated Verification` heading, at start, at the plan check and at a plan edit during a /code run. Before, plan_format read a phase's verification commands only under the exact heading, so a misworded one counted as no commands and the phase closed green with nothing run.
* [The code step checks the criteria file under any Acceptance heading](2026-10-24-the-code-step-checks-the-criteria-file-under-any.md) [script/code-step, script/plan-format] The code step now stops on a missing or empty acceptance-criteria.md under any level 2 or 3 heading that starts with Acceptance, case-insensitive. Before, it stopped only when the plan held the exact line `## Acceptance Criteria`; any other wording skipped the check with no output.
* [verify-log refuses a run with no verdict row for a ticket criterion](2026-10-24-verify-log-refuses-a-run-with-no-verdict-row-for-a.md) [script/verify-log, script/verify-prep, agent/plan-verifier, skill/verify-branch] verify-prep now saves the ticket criterion labels, and verify-log exits 2 and writes nothing when a `Ticket #n` has no row. Before, verify-log checked only the acceptance-criteria.md ids, so a ticket-only run, or a task dir with no criteria file, logged CLEAN with any non-empty rows.
* [Metrics writers fold pairs that zsh left in one argument](2026-10-24-metrics-writers-fold-pairs-that-zsh-left-in-one.md) [script/log-escape, script/log-scan, script/log-spec-run, script/log-review-finding, script/log-review-metrics, script/log-review-check] The metrics writers now accept `lane=code scope=phase iter=1` as separate pairs, when every word after the first is name=value and the key is not free text. Before, kv_fold refused it; that is what `C="lane=code scope=phase"; writer $C` sends under zsh, since zsh does not split an unquoted variable. Any other spaced value is still refused.
* [With no ledger on PATH the metrics writers append to the old jsonl files](2026-10-24-with-no-ledger-on-path-the-metrics-writers-append.md) [script/log-escape, script/log-scan, script/log-spec-run, script/log-review-finding, script/log-review-metrics, script/review-scope, script/review-loop-gate] On a machine with no ledger, ledger-write now appends each completed row to the jsonl file its type used before the ledger switch and prints one stderr line. Before, it exited 0 silently, so that machine lost every review finding, review run, review metrics row, escape, spec run and scan run.
* [code-step and coder-gate write their state files atomically](2026-10-24-code-step-and-coder-gate-write-their-state-files.md) [script/code-step, script/coder-gate] save_state and both coder-gate writers write a temp file in the same folder and then replace the target, so a reader that polls during a wait never sees a half-written file.
* [A resumed /code run reaches the right next step](2026-10-24-a-resumed-code-run-reaches-the-right-next-step.md) [script/code-step] A stopped or resumed /code run now reaches the right step in five cases that used to go wrong: a resumed coder at the wait cap, `start after-review` over an open run, a phase given inside task text, a plan-edit coder at the cap, and a review-loop hand-back from an agent the run did not launch.
* [/code continue resumes the saved plan](2026-10-23-code-continue-resumes-the-saved-plan.md) [skill/code] `/code continue` (or `/code` with no text) now runs `code-step.py start` with no argument, which resumes the saved plan. Before, the skill passed the word to `start` as task text, and code-step began a planless run that dropped the plan, left the phase unticked and cut files from the commit.
* [The hand-back check runs with the plan's gate variables](2026-10-23-the-hand-back-check-runs-with-the-plan-s-gate.md) [script/coder-gate, script/code-step] code-step reads the `NAME=value` words that the plan's verification commands start with, plus the repo's gate variables, and stores them in the gate with `coder-gate.py set --env`. The hand-back hook runs every check with them, so it sees the same settings as the coder's own run.
* [The review-loop stop gate counts `cargo test -p core` as a full gate run](2026-10-22-the-review-loop-stop-gate-ignores-package-and.md) [script/review-loop-gate, script/script-utils] review-loop-gate.py no longer reads the value of a package, project or manifest flag as a test filter, so `cargo test -p core` counts as a full gate run. The script also carries a hand-back check that is not registered in settings.json.
* [code-step logs an ask outcome only for a minted finding id](2026-10-22-code-step-logs-an-ask-outcome-only-for-a-minted.md) [script/code-step] code-step's ask-outcome logger now uses handback.ask_finding_id, as review-fix does. It skips and names a placeholder id, and it names a logger failure on stderr.
* [code-step reads a start argument with whitespace as task text](2026-10-22-code-step-reads-a-start-argument-with-whitespace.md) [script/code-step, script/script-utils] `start` no longer treats a word with whitespace as a plan path, unless that word is an existing file. Task text that names a file path now starts a task run.
* [verify-branch retries a busy ledger before it reads the review state](2026-10-22-verify-branch-retries-a-busy-ledger-before-it.md) [script/verify-common, script/script-utils] verify_common.review_ran runs `ledger yield --review-trees` with a 60 s timeout and up to 4 tries when the ledger exits 75 (busy). If the ledger stays busy, it fails with a message that says to run the step again.
* [code-step start stops at an open gated phase](2026-10-22-code-step-start-stops-at-an-open-gated-phase.md) [script/code-step] When an open phase with a gate clause comes before the next ungated phase, `start` now stops and starts nothing. Before, it skipped the gated phases and started a later one.
* [Do not count a gate run that a signal or an interrupt ended](2026-10-22-do-not-count-a-gate-run-that-a-signal-or-an.md) [script/quality-check-cap, script/hook-input] quality-check-cap.py no longer records a failed Bash run that the user interrupted or that a signal ended (exit 129 to 192, timeout kills included), so the cap allows the rerun.
* [Skip ask outcomes whose finding id is a placeholder](2026-10-22-skip-ask-outcomes-whose-finding-id-is-a.md) [script/review-fix, script/handback] review-fix.py asks-done now logs an ask outcome only when its finding_id has the minted shape. A placeholder such as "none logged" is skipped and named, and the command no longer fails.
* [Name the review-loop gate log by branch](2026-10-21-name-the-review-loop-gate-log-by-branch.md) [agent/review-loop] The review loop's full gate run now writes to /tmp/review-gate-<branch>.log, not one shared /tmp/review-gate.log that other sessions overwrite.
* [Goal-blind researcher waits for each child](2026-10-21-goal-blind-researcher-waits-for-each-child.md) [agent/goal-blind-researcher] The goal-blind researcher now waits for each child's completion notice and checks for the file it writes before the next step. It never ends its turn while a child runs.
* [The code skill runs each code-step verb alone so the coder prompt is not cut](2026-10-21-the-code-skill-runs-each-code-step-verb-alone-so.md) [skill/code] The /code skill tells the subagent to run each code-step.py verb as its own Bash call, with no pipe, head, sed or second command. A cut output loses the coder prompt.
* [Criteria parser skips a bold AC id inside a note but still refuses a miswritten criterion line](2026-10-21-criteria-parser-skips-a-bold-ac-id-inside-a-note.md) [script/verify-common, skill/verify-branch] verify_common.criteria_file no longer refuses an acceptance-criteria file because a note line has an unclosed bold **ACn's ... mid-line. A line that starts with a bold id, or holds a closed bold id span anywhere, and does not match `- **ACn** — text` still fails.
* [code-step says when a phase lists no verification commands and drops (last phase) when gated phases remain](2026-10-21-code-step-says-when-a-phase-lists-no-verification.md) [script/code-step] When a phase lists no verification commands, the phase-done text says that none were run, not "0 command(s) green". The Phase N complete line leaves out "(last phase)" when only gated phases remain. after-review and the handback hook share one helper that puts a resumed review loop back.
* [A refactor or review finding can log a file path that holds spaces](2026-10-21-a-refactor-or-review-finding-can-log-a-file-path.md) [script/refactor-flow, script/log-escape, script/log-review-finding] refactor-flow.py log, log-escape and log-review-finding accept a file= value with spaces. All three refuse a file= value that holds a line break, or whitespace followed by name=, which is the shape of a swallowed key=value pair.
* [Format hook skips formatting while a git merge, cherry-pick, revert or rebase is unfinished](2026-10-21-format-hook-skips-formatting-while-a-git-merge.md) [script/format-changed] The Stop step of format-changed.py formats nothing while the git dir holds MERGE_HEAD, CHERRY_PICK_HEAD, REVERT_HEAD, rebase-merge, rebase-apply, SQUASH_MSG or MERGE_MSG. Files that a merge brings in are no longer reformatted before the merge commit.
* [code-step waits for a resumed agent, needs a dispatch time, and skips gated phases](2026-10-21-code-step-waits-for-a-resumed-agent-needs-a.md) [script/code-step, script/plan-format, skill/plan-format] code-step waits for the hand-back of the coder or review loop of this phase, including one resumed by SendMessage. It stops when a state has no dispatch time, instead of reading an earlier row. start skips an open phase whose status line has a gate clause, and names it.
* [The repeat-check cap counts each agent's own runs and trusts a formatter only before a sure check](2026-10-21-the-repeat-check-cap-counts-each-agent-s-own-runs.md) [script/quality-check-cap, script/shell-command] The repeat-check cap keeps a separate record for each subagent, so a reviewer or the review loop gets its own first run of a check. A formatter exempts a check only when the check surely runs after the formatter succeeds.
* [The comment-bloat gate checks only files inside a git repo](2026-10-21-the-comment-bloat-gate-checks-only-files-inside-a.md) [script/comment-bloat-gate, script/script-utils] The comment-bloat gate blocks a write only when the file resolves into a git work tree. Scratch files, probes and temp scripts outside a repo are not committed code, and the gate blocked them.
* [code-step stops when it cannot read a phase's checks](2026-10-21-code-step-stops-when-it-cannot-read-a-phase-s.md) [script/code-step, script/plan-format] code-step now reads more command forms, including `cargo`, so Rust phases run their tests, and it stops a phase whose Automated Verification item stays unreadable. The same batch fixes how it joins coder reports, revives a stopped coder and writes the commit prefix. Before, it marked such a phase done after running none of its checks.
* [Calibration and mutation locks move out of the Claude config folder](2026-10-21-calibration-and-mutation-locks-move-out-of-the.md) [agent/mutation-tester, skill/calibrate, script/calibration-guard] The mutation tester and /calibrate write their lock and backups under the XDG state folder, not under ~/.claude. The auto-mode classifier denied writes under ~/.claude, so mutation runs ended INDETERMINATE.
* [The repeat-check cap counts only checks that ran and sees git changes](2026-10-21-the-repeat-check-cap-counts-only-checks-that-ran.md) [script/quality-check-cap] The quality-check cap denies a repeat check only when the earlier run surely ran and the working tree did not change. It sees git merges and commits, never denies a formatter that writes, and lets the review loop's gate run through.
* [The comment-bloat gate reads only comment lines in JSON files](2026-10-21-the-comment-bloat-gate-reads-only-comment-lines-in.md) [script/comment-bloat-gate] The comment-bloat gate no longer reads JSON values as comments. It blocked writes of JSON fixtures and test files that held long string values.
* Regression: [The review-loop gate run now runs: it no longer ends with the repeat-check skip marker](2026-10-21-the-review-loop-gate-run-drops-the-repeat-check.md) [agent/review-loop] The review loop's Step 6 gate run no longer ends with a skip marker for the repeat-check cap, so the auto-mode classifier stops denying it. Before, the classifier denied every command that carried the marker and the gate run never ran. This reverses the 2026-10-20 change.
* [The branch recap writes no receipt, not clean, when the test audit left no receipt](2026-10-21-the-branch-recap-writes-no-receipt-not-clean-when.md) [skill/branch-recap] The recap sheet and the recap telemetry row now say "no receipt" when no /test-audit receipt is in context. Before, the recap wrote "clean" with no audit behind it.
* [The review-loop stop gate lets a stop pass while the loop waits on its own agents](2026-10-21-the-review-loop-stop-gate-lets-a-stop-pass-while.md) [script/review-loop-gate] review-loop-gate.py no longer blocks a review loop's stop while one of the loop's background agents has not reported. The loop ends its turn to wait for each report, and the gate read every wait as an attempt to finish.
* [Read only review reports saved after the latest review dispatch](2026-10-20-read-only-review-reports-saved-after-the-latest.md) [script/code-step] after-review in the /code step machine now reads only reports saved after the latest review dispatch, so a report is acted on once. Before, it read an old plan-impact review report again when a later review saved no report, asked the plan-change question again, started another review and added another Plan Deviations entry, in a loop that ended only when a reviewer handed back.

## Week of 2026-10-12

### Added

* [The code-layout rule stays prompt-only: the `code_layout_gate.py` hook was added and removed the same day](2026-10-17-a-posttooluse-hook-on-write-and-edit-code-layout.md) [rule/settings-json] The code-layout rule in CLAUDE.md stays as prompt text only. A PostToolUse hook, `code_layout_gate.py`, was added to block new code that passed a call result straight into a call that was itself an argument, or that ran more than 8 statements in one block with no blank line, and was removed the same day.
* [New Bash hook `inline-interpreter-hint.py` denies the inline interpreter runs the safety gate blocks and names the way around](2026-10-14-new-bash-pretooluse-hook-inline-interpreter-hint.md) [script/inline-interpreter-hint] New Bash PreToolUse hook `inline-interpreter-hint.py`: denies exactly the inline interpreter runs the generated safety gate blocks, with text naming the way around (write a scratchpad file and run it; run the interpreter step as its own call when no inline code runs).
* [New bench agents `plan-fanout-window-opus` and `plan-window-view-opus`](2026-10-12-new-bench-agents-plan-fanout-window-opus-and-plan.md) [agent/plan-fanout-window-opus, agent/plan-window-view-opus] New bench agents `plan-fanout-window-opus` and `plan-window-view-opus`: the three-phase-window plan review with Opus as the window reviewers instead of Sonnet.
* [New bench-only agents `plan-fanout-window` and `plan-window-view`: fan-out plan review over three-phase windows, 7 agents instead of 15](2026-10-12-new-agents-plan-fanout-window-opus-pinned-and-plan.md) [agent/plan-fanout-window, agent/plan-window-view] New agents `plan-fanout-window` (Opus, pinned) and `plan-window-view` (Sonnet, pinned): the same fan-out plan review, but each Sonnet agent reads a three-phase window (overlapping by one phase) and never the full plan, 7 agents instead of 15.
* [New bench-only agents `plan-fanout` and `plan-coder-view`: plan review with one Sonnet agent per phase, merged by Opus](2026-10-12-new-agents-plan-fanout-opus-pinned-and-plan-coder.md) [agent/plan-fanout, agent/plan-coder-view] New agents `plan-fanout` (Opus, pinned) and `plan-coder-view` (Sonnet, pinned): a plan review that sends one Sonnet agent per phase, each reading its phase as the coder who builds it next, then has Opus verify, dedupe and merge their issues.
