## Week of 2026-09-07

### Added

* [A new skill saves the session's state to a handoff file so the next task can start from disk](2026-09-13-a-new-user-invoked-skill-writes-the-session-s.md) [skill/handoff] A new user-invoked skill writes the session's state at a task boundary — what shipped, what was decided, the numbers to keep, what is open, the rules that bind the next step, and the files to reopen — to a handoff file outside the repo.
* [New gate stops a test, lint or type-check command rerun with no file edit in between](2026-09-12-new-gate-refusing-a-project-s-own-test-lint-or.md) [script/quality-check-cap] New gate refusing a project's own test, lint or type-check command when it is run a second time with no file edit in between, telling the caller to send the failing run to a log, read the whole log, fix every failure at once, and run again.
* [New gate refusing any shell command that writes to a tracked file by redirection or appending](2026-09-12-new-gate-refusing-any-shell-command-that-writes-to.md) [script/shell-write-gate] New gate refusing any shell command that writes to a tracked file by redirection or appending, and refusing in-place editing outright, on tracked and untracked paths alike.
* [New warn-only check reports cited repository paths and line numbers that no longer resolve](2026-09-12-new-warn-only-check-on-every-written-file-in.md) [script/stale-citation-gate] New warn-only check on every written file: in documents it extracts each cited repository path and reports the ones that no longer resolve, plus line numbers past the end of the file they point into.
* [New fresh-eyes plan reader reviews a finalized plan before any coder runs](2026-09-07-new-fresh-eyes-plan-reader-that-reviews-a.md) [agent/plan-reviewer] New fresh-eyes plan reader that reviews a finalized plan before any coder runs — given the plan, ticket and acceptance criteria by path and nothing from the conversation that produced them — reporting dangling dependencies, contracts that disagree between phases, ticket requirements no phase owns.

(reverted by 2026-09-13-the-plan-reviewer-s-instruction-to-batch-its-tree)

* [The plan reader now verifies every factual assertion a plan makes about the repository](2026-09-12-the-plan-reader-now-treats-every-factual-assertion.md) [agent/plan-reviewer] The plan reader now treats every factual assertion a plan makes about the repository as unverified and runs the command that settles it; resolves every cited path, line number, rule number, section heading and cross-document reference against the tree as it currently stands.
* [The diff reviewer now audits every guard and check a change touches against the contract it claims to enforce](2026-09-12-a-required-audit-in-the-diff-reviewer-that-reads.md) [agent/code-reviewer] A required audit in the diff reviewer that reads every guard, filter, lint rule, validation check, tolerance, exception handler and equality predicate the change touches against the contract it claims to enforce — its own name, docstring, rule id, the documented meaning of a config key.
* [Telemetry rows now record the repo rather than the checkout](2026-09-07-telemetry-rows-now-record-the-repo-rather-than-the.md) [script/log-review-finding, script/log-escape] Telemetry rows now record the repo rather than the checkout, the finding-class vocabulary is validated and gains a `docs` value, and a gate's verdict is spelling-normalized instead of refused.

### Removed

* [The plan reviewer runs on about two fifths fewer tokens without the batch-your-tree-checks instruction](2026-09-13-the-plan-reviewer-s-instruction-to-batch-its-tree.md) [agent/plan-reviewer] The plan reviewer now runs without the instruction to batch its tree checks, and uses about two fifths fewer tokens per run. **cuts tokens by 38% (1.3M → 800k)** (reverted by 2026-09-13-the-plan-reviewer-s-instruction-to-batch-its-tree-2)

# Unmeasured behavior changes

* [Toolkit edits need a bench proof sized by task class](2026-10-24-toolkit-edits-need-a-bench-proof-sized-by-task.md) - it gates the ledger and dotfiles commits on this machine, which no work intake reads; the ledger itself shows whether change files carry proof
* [The metrics switch reads only the environment variable](2026-10-24-the-metrics-switch-reads-only-the-environment.md) - The change decides only whether metrics rows are written, not what any agent does. The intake's toolkit-telemetry line reads the switch on each pull.
* [Escape loggers file false or stale prose as docs](2026-10-24-escape-loggers-file-false-or-stale-prose-as-docs.md) - The before period has almost no docs escapes because the skills never offered the class, so a before-and-after watch on the class reads a false rise. Read it as a share: once about 40 new review escapes have landed, count the docs share of review escapes and compare it with the census share of false or stale prose.
* [Toolkit scripts sorted into code, review, gates, telemetry, lib and tools folders](2026-10-24-toolkit-scripts-sorted-into-code-review-gates.md) - A pure move. Every hook command, import and printed text keeps its behavior, so no intake number moves. The gain is finding a script by concern, which no stream counts.
